problems.title: Safe following distance
problems.problem:
Problem 1

For safe driving on a highway there must be a certain longitudinal gap between two vehicles. Experiments have established that on average the total reaction time of the driver and the car can be taken as $1\ \mathrm{s}$ when driving on a highway. Find the minimum safe longitudinal gap between two cars when driving at a speed of $90\ \mathrm{km/h}$. The cars may be considered identical. (5 points)

problems.title: Perfectly inelastic collision with friction
problems.problem:
Problem 2

Two bodies of masses $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ and $1.5\ \mathrm{kg}$ move towards each other on a horizontal plane, collide perfectly inelastically and then move on together. The speeds of the bodies immediately before the collision were $1\ \mathrm{m/s}$ and $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$. For how long and how far from the point of collision do these bodies move, and how large is the work of the friction forces, if the coefficient of friction is $0.05$? (7 points)

Kehade kiirused vahetult enne põrget olid $1\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ja $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Kui kaua ja kui kaugele põrkekohast liiguvad need kehad ning kui suur on hõõrdejõudude töö, hõõrdetegur on $0{,}05$? problems.title: Wet and dry bulb thermometers
problems.problem:
Problem 10

One method of determining the relative humidity of the air consists in establishing the difference between the readings of a dry and a wet thermometer. The wet thermometer is otherwise an ordinary thermometer, except that a damp rag has been wrapped around its sensor, and wind is blown onto the rag and the sensor. To answer the questions below you have a graph showing the dependence of the saturated water vapour pressure on temperature. In part $a)$ you may take the thermal conductivity of the air to be negligibly small, i.e. take the heat flow due to thermal conduction to be equal to zero.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-1997-10-fig1.png

a) Find the difference between the readings of the dry and wet thermometers at $t=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and relative humidity $r=90\ \%$ (10 points);

b) Assume that the wind is blown all the time with one and the same intensity. Then the heat flow $Q_{sj}$ ($\mathrm{J/s}$) due to thermal conduction is proportional to the difference between the temperature $T_0$ of the air and the temperature $T$ of the wet rag, $Q_{sj}=a\cdot(T_0-T)$. Here the proportionality coefficient $a$ depends on the area and shape of the wet rag and on the wind speed. The heat flow $Q_a$ due to the evaporation of water is proportional to the intensity of evaporation, which in turn is proportional to the difference between the saturated vapour pressure and the actual vapour pressure, i.e. $Q_a=b\cdot[p_k(T)-p_a]$. The coefficient $b$ depends on the same factors, but it turns out that the ratio $a/b$ is in fact constant --- provided that the saturated vapour pressure is much smaller than the air pressure. It depends only on the air pressure and the temperature, but for the given temperature range this dependence is negligible, and you may take $a/b=65\ \mathrm{Pa/K}$ at normal pressure. Taking the above into account, what would the reading of the wet thermometer be if the air were kept absolutely dry (i.e. $r=0$)? (4 points)

c) Derive an expression as simple as possible for the approximate calculation of the difference between the readings of the thermometers, applicable for $t=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and $80\ \%<r<100\ \%$ and giving the answer with an accuracy of about $10\ \%$ (4 points).

d) Laundry has been hung up to dry in the shade, in the wind. In one case the humidity of the air is $95\ \%$, in the other $80\ \%$; the other conditions are exactly the same. How many times faster does the laundry dry in the second case? (2 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10

Üks meetod õhu relatiivse niiskuse määramiseks seisneb selles, et tehakse kindlaks kuiva ja märja termomeetri näitude erinevus. Märg termomeeter on muidu nagu termomeeter ikka, ainult et tema sensori ümber on mässitud niiske lapp ning lapi ja sensori peale lehvitatakse tuult. Alljärgnevatele küsimustele vastamiseks on teil kasutada graafik, millel on kujutatud küllastunud veeauru rõhu sõltuvus temperatuurist. Punktis $a)$ võite lugeda õhu soojusjuhtivuse tühiselt väikeseks, s.o. võtta soojusjuhtivusest tingitud soojusvoog võrdseks nulliga.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-1997-10-fig1.png

a) Leidke kuiva ja märja termomeetri näitude vahe $t=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ning relatiivse niiskuse $r=90\ \%$ juures (10 p.);

b) Kui eeldada, et tuult lehvitatakse kogu aeg ühe ja sama intensiivsusega, siis soojusjuhtivusest tingitud soojusvoog $Q_{sj}$ ($\mathrm{J/s}$) on võrdeline õhu temperatuuri $T_0$ ja märja lapi temperatuuri $T$ vahega, $Q_{sj}=a\cdot(T_0-T)$. Siinjuures võrdetegur $a$ sõltub märja lapi pindalast, kujust ja tuule kiirusest. Vee aurustumisest tingitud soojusvoog $Q_a$ on võrdeline aurustumise intensiivsusega, mis omakorda on võrdeline küllastunud aurururõhu ja tegeliku aururõhu vahega, s.o. $Q_a=b\cdot[p_k(T)-p_a]$. Koefitsient $b$ sõltub samadest teguritest, kuid selgub, et suhe $a/b$ on faktiliselt konstantne --- seda eeldusel et küllastunud aururõhk on hulga väiksem õhurõhust. Ta sõltub ainult õhurõhust ning temperatuurist, kuid antud temperatuurivahemiku jaoks on see sõltuvus tühine ning Te võite lugeda, et normaalrõhu juures $a/b=65\ \mathrm{Pa/K}$. Arvestades eelpooltoodut, milline oleks märja termomeetri näit siis, kui õhk hoitaks absoluutselt kuivana (s.o. $r=0$)? (4 p.)

c) Tuletage võimalikult lihtne avaldis termomeetrite näitude vahe ligikaudseks arvutamiseks, mis oleks rakendatav $t=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ja $80\ \%<r<100\ \%$ jaoks ning annaks vastuse ca $10\ \%$ täpsusega (4 p.).

d) Pesu on riputatud kuivama vilusse tuule kätte. Ühel juhtumil on õhu niiskus $95\ \%$, teisel juhtumil $80\ \%$; muud tingimused on täpselt samad. Mitu korda kuivab pesu teisel juhtumil kiiremini? (2 p.)

problems.title: Pumping a car tyre
problems.problem:
Problem 5

(6 points) A car tyre is inflated with a hand pump; the pressure gauge shows the difference between the inside and outside pressure as $p_1=2\times10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$, the outside pressure is $p_0=1\times10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Find the temperature of the air as it is pushed through the valve into the inside of the tyre. Assume that when the air has just been drawn into the pump, the air pressure inside the pump equals the outside pressure and its temperature equals the temperature of the outside air, $T=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Assume that there is no heat exchange with the surroundings while the air is compressed in the pump and that all the work done goes into increasing the internal energy of the air. In that case the relation $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{Const.}$ holds, with exponent $\gamma=7/5$. The pressure drop across the opened valve is negligible.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5

(6 punkti) Autokummi pumbatakse käsipumbaga; manomeeter näitab sise- ja välisrõhu vaheks $p_1=2\times10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$, välisrõhk $p_0=1\times10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Leidke, millise temperatuuriga õhk surutakse läbi ventiili kummi sisemusse. Lugeda, et kui õhk on just pumpa imetud, siis pumba sisemuses õhu rõhk võrdub välisrõhuga ning temperatuur välisõhu temperatuuriga $T=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Eeldada, et õhu kokku surumisel pumbas soojusvahetust ümbritseva keskkonnaga ei toimu ning kogu tehtud töö läheb õhu siseenergia suurendamiseks. Sellisel juhul kehtib seos $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{Const.}$, kus astmenäitaja $\gamma=7/5$. Rõhu langus avanenud ventiilil on tühine.

problems.title: Braking and the effective friction coefficient
problems.problem:
Problem 8

(12 points) Experiments showed that when a car starts braking at a speed $v_0=60\ \mathrm{km/h}$, the dependence of the effective coefficient of friction on the slip speed $u$ of the wheels is as shown in the figure. The figure also shows the graph for a speed $v_1=30\ \mathrm{km/h}$. As can be seen, the main changes take place in the part of the graph lying towards speeds smaller than the maximum. The position of the maximum is proportional to $v$, and the value of the maximum practically does not depend on $v$. The slip speed is defined as the difference between the speed of the car and the rotational speed of the outer surface of the wheels (the latter measured in the frame attached to the car). Henceforth we assume that the tyres and road conditions of the cars are exactly the same as in the experiments.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-1998-8-fig1.png

a*) (3 points) How large is the braking distance of such a car, travelling at speed $v_0$ and equipped with an ABS system that keeps the slip speed at the maximum of the effective coefficient of friction all the time?

b) (4 points) Sketch a graph showing the coefficient of friction between the wheels and the road of a car without an ABS system as a function of the speed of the car when the car brakes with locked wheels (i.e. the wheels do not rotate).

c) (5 points) A simplified model of a car tyre is such that the treaded upper surface of the rubber has studs that deform during braking (see the figure). Let the distance between two consecutive studs in the undeformed state be $a$. The relative deformation of the tyre surface can be characterised by the quantity $\varepsilon=(a'-a)/a$, where $a'$ denotes the distance between the two studs in the deformed state, see the figure. Find the maximum relative deformation $\varepsilon$ of the tyre surface during braking.

problems.title: Hollow cylinder pulled by a thread
problems.problem:
Problem 9

(14 points) A hollow cylinder of mass $m$ and radius $R$ stands on a horizontal surface (a top view is shown in the figure); its lower edge is smooth and in contact with the surface everywhere. A thread is wound around the cylinder, and its free end is pulled with constant speed $v$ along the direction of the thread. Find the speed with which the cylinder moves. Consider two cases separately:

a) (11 points) the coefficient of friction between the surface and the cylinder is zero everywhere, except for a narrow straight strip (much narrower than the radius of the cylinder) with coefficient of friction $\mu$, which is parallel to the thread and whose distance from the thread is $a<2R$;

b) (3 points) the coefficient of friction of the surface is constant everywhere and equal to $\mu$.

Hint: an arbitrary motion of a rigid body can be regarded as a rotation about an instantaneous axis of rotation, i.e. the velocity vector of every point of the body is exactly the same as if the instantaneous axis were a real axis of rotation.

problems.title: Air temperature on a hilltop
problems.problem:
Problem 6

What is the air temperature on the top of a hill of height $H=200\ \mathrm{m}$ if it is $t_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ warm at the foot? When air masses move up or down, the expansion and compression of the air may be considered an adiabatic process. The air pressure at ground level is $p_0=10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$, the density of air is $\rho=1.29\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Hint: for an adiabatic process the relation $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$ holds. When the pressure change $\Delta p$ is small ($\Delta p\ll p$), the previous formula may be replaced by the approximate formula $\Delta p/p=-\gamma\Delta V/V$. For air the adiabatic exponent is $\gamma=1.4$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6

Milline on õhu temperatuur $H=200\ \mathrm{m}$ kõrguse mäe otsas, kui jalamil on sooja $t_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$? Õhumasside liikumisel üles- või allapoole võib õhu paisumise ja kokkusurumise lugeda adiabaatiliseks protsessiks. Õhurõhk maapinnal $p_0=10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$, õhu tihedus $\rho=1{,}29\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Juhtnöör: adiabaatilise protsessi puhul kehtib seos $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$. Kui rõhu muutus $\Delta p$ on väike ($\Delta p\ll p$), siis võib eelmise valemi asendada ligikaudse valemiga $\Delta p/p=-\gamma\Delta V/V$. Õhu jaoks on adiabaadi astendaja $\gamma=1{,}4$. (10 p.)

problems.title: Wire sliding on rails in a magnetic field
problems.problem:
Problem 8

Two straight parallel copper wires at a distance $a=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ from each other lie in the same horizontal plane in a vertical homogeneous magnetic field of magnetic induction $B=100\ \mathrm{mT}$. A piece of copper wire of mass $m=5.0\ \mathrm{g}$ is placed across the wires, perpendicular to them. The piece of wire can slide along the wires while remaining in electrical contact with them, the coefficient of friction being $\mu=0.204$. Close to the piece of wire a current source with electromotive force $E=5.0\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $r=1.0\ \Omega$ is connected between the two wires. As a result the piece of wire starts to move.

(a) Find the speed of the piece of wire at a distance $l=1.0\ \mathrm{m}$ from the starting point. Electromagnetic induction may be neglected here.

(b) Find the acceleration of the piece of wire at the same point, now taking into account the effect of electromagnetic induction (the expression for the speed found in part a may still be used here). Take the acceleration of gravity to be $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$; neglect the resistance of the copper wires and of the contact surface. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8

Kaks sirget paralleelset vaskjuhet vahekaugusega $a=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ asuvad samal horisontaaltasandil vertikaalses homogeenses magnetväljas, mille magnetinduktsioon $B=100\ \mathrm{mT}$. Juhtmete peale on nendega risti asetatud vasest traaditükk massiga $m=5{,}0\ \mathrm{g}$. Traaditükk võib libiseda piki juhtmeid, olles nendega elektrilises kontaktis, kusjuures hõõrdetegur $\mu=0{,}204$. Traaditüki vahetus läheduses ühendatakse kahe juhtme vahele vooluallikas elektromotoorjõuga $E=5{,}0\ \mathrm{V}$ ja sisetakistusega $r=1{,}0\ \Omega$. Selle tulemusena hakkab traaditükk liikuma.

(a) Leida traaditüki kiirus $l=1{,}0\ \mathrm{m}$ kaugusel stardikohast. Elektromagnetilise induktsiooniga võib seejuures mitte arvestada.

(b) Leida traaditüki kiirendus samas punktis, arvestades seejuures ka elektromagnetilise induktsiooni mõju (punktis a leitud kiiruse avaldist võib seejuures siiski kasutada). Raskuskiirenduseks lugeda $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, vaskjuhtmete ja kontaktpinna takistust mitte arvestada. (10 p.)

problems.title: Bacterium in sunlight
problems.problem:
Problem 9

An absolutely black spherical bacterium of density $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ has strayed into interplanetary space. If the bacterium is small enough, the pressure of the Sun's radiation flux pushes it out into interstellar space. For what maximum radius $r_\text{b}$ of the bacterium does this still happen? The total radiated power of the Sun is $L_\odot=3.8\cdot10^{26}\ \mathrm{W}$ and its mass is $M_\odot=2.0\cdot10^{30}\ \mathrm{kg}$; the gravitational constant is $G=6.67\cdot10^{-11}\ \mathrm{m^3/(kg\cdot s^2)}$. Hint: Light can be regarded as a flux of photons, each photon carrying momentum $p$ and energy $E$. The values of $E$ and $p$ depend on the wavelength of the light, but their ratio is always one and the same, $E/p=c=3.0\cdot10^8\ \mathrm{m/s}$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:

Juhtnöör: Valgust võib vaadelda kui footonite voogu, kus iga footon kannab impulssi $p$ ja energiat $E$. $E$ ja $p$ väärtused sõltuvad valguse lainepikkusest, kuid nende suhe on alati üks ja sama, $E/p=c=3{,}0\cdot10^8\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Note: through a layer of ice of thickness $d$ and cross-sectional area $S$, an amount of heat $\Delta Q=k(t_1-t_2)\Delta\tau S/d$ passes in a time interval $\Delta\tau$. Problem 7

A certain car can brake only with its front wheels. The coefficient of static friction between the tyre rubber and the ground is $\mu$. The centre of mass of the car is at height $H$ and the distance between the wheel axles is $2L$. The weight of the stationary car is distributed evenly between the wheels. What is the maximum deceleration with which this car can be braked? Note: One may use a reference frame moving with acceleration $\vec a$, but then every body is acted upon by an inertial force $-m\vec a$, applied at the centre of mass of the body. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:

Märkus: Võib kasutada kiirendusega $\vec a$ liikuvat taustsüsteemi, kuid seal mõjub igale kehale inertsijõud $-m\vec a$, mis on rakendatud keha massikeskmele. (10 p.)

problems.title: Tidal destruction of a moon

Problem 8

Show that the gravity of the planet destroys the moon if the latter is closer to the planet than $\sqrt[3]{3\rho_p/\rho_k}\,R_p$, where $\rho_p$ is the mean density of the planet, $\rho_k$ is the mean density of the moon and $R_p$ is the radius of the planet. Assume that the radius of the moon is much smaller than the distance between the moon and the planet. The moon orbits/rotates so that it always faces the planet with the same side. Note: Use the approximation $(1+x)^n\approx 1+nx$ for $x\ll 1$. The moon may be regarded as a spherical homogeneous solid body that is held together by its own gravity. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8

Näidata, et planeedi raskusjõud purustab kuu, kui viimane asub planeedile lähemal kui $\sqrt[3]{3\rho_p/\rho_k}\,R_p$, kus $\rho_p$ on planeedi keskmine tihedus, $\rho_k$ on kuu keskmine tihedus ja $R_p$ on planeedi raadius. Eeldada, et kuu raadius on palju väiksem kuu ja planeedi vahelisest kaugusest. Kuu tiirleb/pöörleb nii, et ta on kogu aeg sama küljega planeedi poole. Märkus: Kasutada lähendust $(1+x)^n\approx 1+nx$, kui $x\ll 1$. Kuud võib vaadelda kui kerakujulist homogeenset tahket keha, mis püsib koos tänu oma raskusjõule. (12 p.)

problems.title: Optical fibre splitter
problems.problem:
Problem 9

In fibre-optic systems an important device is the so-called splitter. It is a very simple device: two fibres are brought into such close contact (see Fig. 4) that when a light wave enters along one fibre, it partly „leaks“ into the other fibre, and light then exits along both fibres. For a so-called equal splitter the amplitudes of the outgoing light waves are equal. (total 14 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2001-9-fig1.png

(a) Prove that if a light wave enters an equal splitter along one fibre, there is a $90^\circ$ phase shift between the light waves leaving along the two fibres. Hint: use the law of conservation of energy. Depending on the chosen method of solution, the formula $\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$ may turn out to be useful. (7 points)

(b) Two equal splitters are placed one after the other as shown in Figure 5. The lengths of the fibres between the splitters differ by $\Delta l=30\ \mu\mathrm{m}$. Light is sent into fibre number 1 from a laser with adjustable wavelength. The wavelength is varied in the range from $\lambda_{\min}=610\ \mathrm{nm}$ to $\lambda_{\max}=660\ \mathrm{nm}$ (this is the wavelength of the wave propagating in the fibre, not the wavelength in vacuum). For which wavelengths does all the light leave along fibre no. 2? (7 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2001-9-fig2.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9

Fiiberoptilistes süsteemides on oluliseks seadmeks nn. jagaja. See on väga lihtne seade: kaks kiudu viiakse nii tihedasse kontakti (vt. joon. 4), et kui ühte kiudu mööda siseneb valguslaine, siis „valgub“ ta osaliselt teise kiudu ning valgus väljub juba mõlemat kiudu mööda. Nn. võrdjagaja puhul on väljuvate valguslainete amplituudid võrdsed. (kokku 14 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2001-9-fig1.png

(a) Tõestage, et kui võrdjagajasse siseneb ühte kiudu mööda valguslaine, siis kahte kiudu mööda väljuvate valguslainete vahel on $90^\circ$-ne faasinihe. Soovitus: kasutage energia jäävuse seadust. Vastavalt valitud lahendusmeetodile võib osutuda kasulikuks valem $\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$. (7 p.)

(b) Kaks võrdjagajat asetatakse järjestikku nii, nagu näidatud joonisel 5. Jagajate vaheliste kiudude pikkused erinevad $\Delta l=30\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ võrra. Reguleeritava lainepikkusega laserist lastakse valgust fiibrisse number 1. Lainepikkust muudetakse vahemikus $\lambda_{\min}=610\ \mathrm{nm}$ kuni $\lambda_{\max}=660\ \mathrm{nm}$ (see on fiibris leviva laine pikkus, mitte lainepikkus vaakumis). problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3

Halogeenpirn võimsusega $P=1000\ \mathrm{W}$ valgustab $a=1\ \mathrm{m}$ kaugusel asuvat pinda $k=50$ korda nõrgemini, kui pinnale risti langev päikesevalgus (so. ajaühikus pindalaühiku kohta tuleva valguse energia on $k=50$ korda väiksem). Päikesepaistelisel päeval on 1000 W-se halogeenlambiga vilgutades võimalik anda märku kuni $L=1\ \mathrm{km}$ kaugusel asuvale sõbrale (kui sõber teab tähelepanelikult vaadata). Kui kaugele on võimalik märku anda kasutades $S=1\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ suurust peeglitükki (peegeldades sellega päikesevalgust)? Eeldada, et nähtavus on hea (valguse hajumisega õhus pole vaja arvestada) ning varjavaid objekte pole (näiteks sõber on merel, teie aga kõrgel merekaldal). Päikese nurkdiameeter on $\alpha=0{,}5^\circ$. (9 p.)

problems.title: Signals between two houses
problems.problem:
Problem 4

Jaan lives in the house next to Juku's and wants to be able to send Juku, as needed, four types of signals. They have two light bulbs, which are taken into Juku's room, and a four-position switch, which stays with Jaan. The switch connects the lower terminal to the upper terminal corresponding to the given position. They want that, according to the position of the switch, (1) --- neither bulb is lit; (2) --- the first is lit; (3) --- the second is lit; (4) --- both are lit. They both get electricity from a common substation. In addition to the above, they have one single-core wire that reaches from one house to the other, four diodes and a handful of short pieces of wire. The houses have no residual-current protection.$^{1}$ Draw a diagram showing how these components should be connected. Do the lamps burn at nominal brightness? (9 points)

$^{1}$ Residual-current protection switches off the voltage as soon as the difference of the currents in the wires is greater than (for example) $20\ \mathrm{mA}$. This helps to avoid life-threatening electric shocks: if the current coming along one wire no longer returns along the other wire but goes to the ground through a person who has come under voltage, a difference of currents arises in the two wires and the protection breaks the circuit.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4

Jaan elab Juku naabermajas ja tahab, et ta saaks vastavalt vajadusele saata Jukule nelja tüüpi signaale. Neil on kaks lambipirni, mis viiakse Juku tuppa ja nelja positsiooniga lüliti, mis jääb Jaani juurde. Lüliti ühendab alumise klemmi antud positsioonile vastava ülemise klemmiga. Nad tahavad, et vastavalt lüliti asendile (1) --- ei põle kumbki pirn; (2) --- põleb esimene; (3) --- põleb teine; (4) --- põlevad mõlemad. Elektrit saavad nad mõlemad ühisest alajaamast. Peale eelpoolmainitu on neil veel üks ühe soonega juhe, mis ulatub ühest majast teiseni, neli dioodi ja pihutäis lühikesi juhtmejuppe. Majades ei ole lekkevoolukaitset.$^{1}$ Joonistage skeem, kuidas tuleks need komponendid ühendada. Kas lambid põlevad nominaalheledusega? (9 p.)

$^{1}$ Lekkevoolukaitse lülitab pinge maha niipea, kui voolutugevuste erinevus juhtmetes on suurem, kui (näiteks) $20\ \mathrm{mA}$. See aitab vältida eluohtlikke elektrilööke: kui ühte juhet pidi tulev vool ei lähe enam teist juhet pidi tagasi, vaid pinge alla sattunud inimest mööda maha, siis tekib kahes juhtmes voolude erinevus ning kaitse katkestab ahela.

problems.title: Grid car racing
problems.problem:
Problem 6

The so-called car race is played by two or more players on squared paper as illustrated in the figure. Each player has their own „car“, which is a point at an intersection of lines. The „car“ is moved forward (by marking a new position point on the paper) in turns. In the figure, $A$ and $B$ denote consecutive positions of one car. The displacement made in each next move may differ from the previous displacement by at most one square side in both the horizontal and the vertical direction. In the figure, nine grey circles would be allowed as the new position of the car, but three of them lie outside the track boundaries (which are drawn before the game starts) and are therefore not allowed (crossed out in the figure).$^{2}$ Suppose that in a real race the coefficient of friction is $\mu=0.6$ and a time interval $\tau=1\ \mathrm{s}$ corresponds to one move of the game. What fast driving does the move from point $A$ to point $B$ (see figure) correspond to? (10 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-6-fig1.png

$^{2}$ Additional rules and recommendations for those who want to play. The squared paper should be at least A4 size. The track is made winding, but there could also be straight sections. The cars start from rest at the starting line; the starting line is also the finishing line. If before a bend the speed of the car is so high that all move options lead outside the track boundaries, one of these moves must nevertheless be made, but the next move is skipped and one has to continue from rest, and outside the track one may not move faster than one square side at a time.

Igal mängijal on oma „auto“, milleks on punkt joonte lõikepunktis. „Autot“ nihutatakse edasi (märkides paberile uue asukohapunkti) kordamööda. Joonisel tähistavad $A$ ja $B$ ühe auto järjestikuseid asukohti. Igal järgmisel käigul tehtud nihe tohib erineda eelmisest nihkest nii horisontaal- kui vertikaalsihis maksimaalselt ühe ruudu külje võrra. Joonisel oleks auto uue asukohana lubatud üheksa halli ringi, kuid kolm neist jäävad raja piiridest välja (see joonistatakse enne mängu algust) ning pole seepärast lubatud (joonisel ristiga maha tõmmatud).$^{2}$ Lugegem, et reaalsel võidusõidul on hõõrdetegur $\mu=0{,}6$ ja ajavahemik $\tau=1\ \mathrm{s}$ vastab mängu ühele käigule. Kui kiirele autosõidule vastab käik punktist $A$ punkti $B$ (vt. joon.)? (10 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-6-fig1.png

$^{2}$ Täiendavaid reegleid ja soovitusi neile, kes tahavad mängida. Ruuduline paber võiks olla vähemalt A4-suurune. Rada tehakse loogeline, kuid sirgeid lõike võiks ka olla. problems.title: Heating an archive
problems.problem:
Problem 7

In an archive storage room the temperature must always be constant, $15^\circ\mathrm{C}$. How much must be paid per year to maintain this temperature? The heat loss per unit time through the walls is given by the formula $P=C\Delta T$, where $C=800\ \mathrm{W/K}$ and $\Delta T$ is the difference between the inside and outside temperatures. A heat pump/air conditioner is used to maintain the temperature; when cooling the room its efficiency is $\eta_{\text{j}}=10$ (the ratio of cooling power to electrical energy consumption), and when heating it is $\eta_{\text{s}}=6$ (the ratio of room heating power to electrical energy consumption). The accompanying $N-T$ graph shows for how many hours $N$ per year the air temperature is higher than $T$. Take the electricity tariff as 92 cents per $\mathrm{kW\cdot h}$. (11 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-7-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7

Arhiivihoidlas peab alati olema konstantne temperatuur $15^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kui palju tuleb aastas maksta selle temperatuuri hoidmiseks? Soojuskaod ajaühikus läbi seinte on antud valemiga $P=C\Delta T$, kus $C=800\ \mathrm{W/K}$ ja $\Delta T$ on sise- ja välistemperatuuri vahe. Temperatuuri hoidmiseks kasutatakse soojuspumpa/konditsioneeri; ruumi jahutamisel on selle efektiivsus $\eta_{\text{j}}=10$ (jahutusvõimsuse ja elektrienergia kulu suhe), soojendamisel aga $\eta_{\text{s}}=6$ (ruumi soojendamisvõimsuse ja elektrienergia kulu suhe). Juuresolev $N-T$-graafik näitab, mitu tundi $N$ aastas on õhutemperatuur kõrgem, kui $T$. Elektrienergia tariifiks võtta 92 senti $\mathrm{kW\cdot h}$ kohta. (11 p.)

problems.title: Mass transfer in a binary star
problems.problem:
Problem 8

The masses of the components of a binary star are $M_1$ and $M_2$. Their initial values are $M_{10}=1.5M_\odot$ and $M_{20}=3M_\odot$ ($M_\odot$ denotes the mass of the Sun) and the system rotates about the common centre of mass in a circular orbit with period $T_0=10\ \mathrm{a}$. Matter flows continuously from the first star to the second star at the rate $\mu=10^{-7}M_\odot/\mathrm{a}$.

(a) Prove that during the process $M_1M_2va=\mathrm{const}$, where $v$ is the relative speed of the stars and $a$ --- the distance between them.

(b) Prove that $v^2a=\mathrm{const}$.

(c) At what rate does the orbital period of the stars change?

Note: The angular momentum of an isolated system is conserved, i.e. $M_1v_1a_1+M_2v_2a_2=\mathrm{const}$, where $a_1$, $a_2$ are the distances of the components from the centre of mass and $v_1$, $v_2$ their speeds. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8

Kaksiktähe komponentide massid on $M_1$ ja $M_2$. Nende algväärtused on $M_{10}=1{,}5M_\odot$ ja $M_{20}=3M_\odot$ ($M_\odot$ tähistab Päikese massi) ning süsteem pöörleb ühise masskeskme ümber ringorbiidil perioodiga $T_0=10\ \mathrm{a}$. Esimeselt tähelt voolab ainet pidevalt teisele tähele kiirusega $\mu=10^{-7}M_\odot/\mathrm{a}$.

(a) Tõestada, et protsessi käigus $M_1M_2va=\mathrm{const}$, kus $v$ on tähtede suhteline kiirus ning $a$ --- nendevaheline kaugus.

(b) Tõestada, et $v^2a=\mathrm{const}$.

(c) Millise kiirusega muutub tähtede tiirlemisperiood?

Märkus: Isoleeritud süsteemi impulsimoment on jääv, s.t. $M_1v_1a_1+M_2v_2a_2=\mathrm{const}$, kus $a_1$, $a_2$ on komponentide kaugused masskeskmest ja $v_1$, $v_2$ nende kiirused. (12 p.)

problems.title: Four-stroke petrol engine
problems.problem:
Problem 9

The main parts of a car petrol engine are a cylinder, a piston moving inside it and a valve for letting gases in and out. The working cycle of the engine consists of four strokes: 1. Intake: the piston moves from its extreme right position to the left; the inside of the cylinder fills with fresh air coming through the open valve. 2. Compression: the valve is closed, the piston moves back to the right, compressing the air adiabatically. 3. Power: fuel is sprayed into the cylinder and ignited. You may assume that the fuel burns instantaneously. The gas, expanding adiabatically, pushes the piston to its extreme left position. 4. Exhaust: the valve is opened, the piston moves to the right and pushes the gases out of the cylinder. A new intake follows, and so on.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-9-fig1.png

(a) Draw the whole cycle in $p-V$ axes and explain the parts of the graph. (6 points)

(b) Find the efficiency $\eta$. (6 points)

Additional data: For an adiabatic process $TV^{\gamma-1}=\mathrm{const}$. For the gas mixture in the cylinder the adiabatic constant is $\gamma=1.4$. The ratio of the largest and smallest volume of the cylinder, $k=V_{\text{s}}/V_{\text{v}}$, is called the compression ratio; take $k=10$. Neglect friction in the flow of the gas and in the motion of the piston. Assume that the amount of gas (i.e. the number of molecules), the specific heat and the adiabatic constant do not change as a result of fuel injection and combustion. Treat the gas mixtures as ideal gases whose internal energy per mole is $U=c_VT$, where $c_V$ is its specific heat at constant volume.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9

Auto bensiinimootori põhiosadeks on silinder, selle sees liikuv kolb ja klapp gaaside sisse-välja laskmiseks. Mootori töötsükkel koosneb neljast taktist: 1. Sisselase: kolb liigub äärmisest parempoolsest asendist vasakule; silindri sisemus täitub läbi avatud klapi tuleva värske õhuga. 2. Surve: klapp suletakse, kolb liigub tagasi paremale surudes õhu adiabaatiliselt kokku. 3. Töö: silindrisse pihustatakse kütust ja see süüdatakse. Võite lugeda, et kütus põleb hetkeliselt ära. Gaas surub adiabaatiliselt paisudes kolvi äärmisse vasakpoolsesse asendisse. 4. Väljalase: klapp avatakse, kolb liigub paremale ja surub silindri gaasidest tühjaks. Järgneb uus sisselase jne.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-9-fig1.png

(a) Joonistage kogu tsükkel $p-V$ teljestikus, selgitage graafiku osasid. (6 p.)

(b) Leidke kasutegur $\eta$. (6 p.)

Lisaandmeid: Adiabaatilise protsessi korral $TV^{\gamma-1}=\mathrm{const}$. Silindris oleva gaasisegu puhul on adiabaadikonstant $\gamma=1{,}4$. Silindri suurima ja vähima ruumala suhet $k=V_{\text{s}}/V_{\text{v}}$ nimetatakse surveastmeks; lugeda, et $k=10$. Hõõrdumist gaasi voolamisel ja kolvi liikumisel mitte arvestada. Lugeda, et gaasi kogus (so. molekulide arv), erisoojus ja adiabaadikonstant kütuse sissepritsimise ning põlemise tulemusel ei muutu. Gaasisegusid vaadelge kui ideaalseid gaase, mille ühe mooli siseenergia on $U=c_VT$, kus $c_V$ on tema erisoojus konstantse ruumala puhul.

problems.title: Fibre ring resonator
problems.problem:
Problem 10

In fibre optics a device called a ring resonator is used. Its diagram is shown in the figure. The fibre (i.e. optical fibre) $A$ and the ring-shaped fibre $B$ are in very weak contact, so that if there were no light wave in fibre $B$, the light wave propagating along fibre $A$ would split in the contact region into waves propagating in fibres $A$ and $B$ whose intensity ratio is $\alpha=100$. Between fibres $B$ and $C$ there is exactly the same kind of weak contact. If the wavelength of the light of constant intensity $I_0$ entering fibre $A$ is varied, then the intensity $I$ of the light reaching the output $A_2$ of fibre $A$ varies as shown in the graph.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-10-fig1.png

(a) Sketch the intensity of the light reaching the end points $C_1$ and $C_2$ of fibre $C$ as a function of wavelength.

(b) What is the intensity of the light in fibre $B$ at wavelength $\lambda_0=1660\ \mathrm{nm}$, if the intensity at the input $A_1$ is $I_0$?

(c) To the wavelength in vacuum $\lambda_0=1660\ \mathrm{nm}$ there corresponds the wavelength in the fibre $\lambda_0'=1000\ \mathrm{nm}$. How long is fibre $B$? (16 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10

Fiiberoptikas kasutatakse seadet, mida nimetatakse ringikujuliseks resonaatoriks. Selle skeem on toodud joonisel. Fiiber (so. valguskiud) $A$ ja ringikujuline fiiber $B$ on hästi nõrgas kontaktis, nii et kui fiibris $B$ valguslaine puuduks, siis fiibrit $A$ mööda leviv valguslaine jaguneks kontaktpiirkonnas fiibrites $A$ ja $B$ levivateks laineteks, mille intensiivsuste suhe on $\alpha=100$. Fiibrite $B$ ja $C$ vahel on täpselt samasugune nõrk kontakt. Kui muuta fiibrisse $A$ siseneva konstantse intensiivsusega $I_0$ valguse lainepikkust, siis fiibri $A$ väljundisse $A_2$ jõudva valguse intensiivsus $I$ muutub nii, nagu näidatud graafikul.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2002-10-fig1.png

(a) Visandage fiibri $C$ otspunktidesse $C_1$ ja $C_2$ jõudva valguse intensiivsus funktsioonina lainepikkusest.

(b) Milline on valguse intensiivsus fiibris $B$ lainepikkuse $\lambda_0=1660\ \mathrm{nm}$ juures, kui sisendis $A_1$ on intensiivsus $I_0$?

(c) Lainepikkusele vaakumis $\lambda_0=1660\ \mathrm{nm}$ vastab lainepikkus fiibris $\lambda_0'=1000\ \mathrm{nm}$. Kui pikk on fiiber $B$? (16 p.)

problems.title: Sea-level recorder
problems.problem:
Problem 4

What is the maximum error of the device shown in the figure, which is meant for recording the fluctuations of the sea level?

Technical data of the device: $R_1=35\ \mathrm{cm}$; $R_2=20\ \mathrm{cm}$; $d=8\ \mathrm{cm}$; $h_1=15\ \mathrm{cm}$; $h_2=15\ \mathrm{cm}$; $m=1\ \mathrm{kg}$; $M=2\ \mathrm{kg}$. The friction force between the pencil and the paper is $F_h=1.2\ \mathrm{N}$. (Use only the data needed for solving the problem)

Principle of operation: at one end of the drum, which is covered with paper, there is a wheel of the same radius as the drum, on which a non-slipping string has been placed. A float is attached to one end of the string, and a weight that keeps the string taut is hung from the other end. When the water rises/falls, the float moves up/down and the drum is thereby also turned. The pencil is moved forward along the axis of the cylinder with constant speed. Thus a dependence between the water level and time is formed on the paper. The bearings of the drum are frictionless. Take the density of sea water to be $1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. (10 points)

Nööri ühes otsas on ujuk ja teise otsa on riputatud nööri pingutav koormis. Kui vesi tõuseb/alaneb, siis liigub ujuk üles/alla ja seega pööratakse ka trumlit. Silindri telje sihis nihutatakse pliiatsit edasi ühtlase kiirusega. Seega moodustub paberile veetaseme ja aja vaheline sõltuvus. Trumli laagrid on hõõrdevabad. problems.title: Hydrogen balloon
problems.problem:
Problem 6

A hydrogen-filled aerostat (an inextensible leather balloon) of volume $V_0$ floats at a stable altitude where the air pressure $p$ and the air temperature $T_{\text{õhk}}$ are constant. In the sunshine the aerostat warmed up to the temperature $T_1$. As a result, part of the gas left the aerostat through a valve which lets gas out but not in, and does not allow the pressure in the aerostat to rise above the external pressure. Then the sun went behind a cloud and the aerostat cooled again to the temperature of the surrounding air, so that its volume decreased. How much ballast must be thrown overboard so that the aerostat keeps its initial altitude? Treat hydrogen and air as ideal gases whose molar masses $\mu_{H_2}$ and $\mu_{\text{õhk}}$ are known. Assume that the altitude of the aerostat practically did not have time to change during the heating and cooling. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6

Vesinikuga täidetud aerostaat (venimatust nahast õhupall) ruumalaga $V_0$ hõljub stabiilsel kõrgusel, kus on muutumatu õhurõhk $p$ ja õhutemperatuur $T_{\text{õhk}}$. Päikesekiirguse käes soojenes aerostaat temperatuurini $T_1$. Selle tulemusel väljus aerostaadist osa gaasi ventiili kaudu, mis laseb gaasi välja, kuid mitte sisse ja ei lase rõhul aerostaadis tõusta kõrgemaks välisrõhust. Seejärel varjus päike pilve taha ja aerostaat jahtus taas ümbritseva õhu temperatuurini, mistõttu tema ruumala vähenes. Kui palju ballasti tuleb üle parda heita, et aerostaat säilitaks algse kõrguse? Vesinik ja õhk lugeda ideaalseteks gaasideks, mille molaarmassid $\mu_{H_2}$ ja $\mu_{\text{õhk}}$ on teada. Eeldada, et aerostaadi kõrgus soojenemise-jahtumise käigus ei jõudnud praktiliselt muutuda. (10 p.)

problems.title: Barrel at the kerb

Problem 8

A cylindrical barrel filled to the brim with water is tightly closed with a lid and rolls with speed $v$ along a smooth square, approaching the kerb of a pavement. What is the speed of the barrel after it has reached the pavement? The radius of the cylinder is $R$, the surface of the pavement is at height $H<R$ above the plane of the square. The kerb has a right-angled profile. The impact of the barrel against the kerb is perfectly inelastic. The mass of the empty barrel is much smaller than the mass of the water. Neglect friction. problems.title: Protons in a switched-on magnetic field
problems.problem:
Problem 10

In a vacuum chamber there are protons (mass $M$, charge $e$) that are spaced so sparsely that their mutual collisions and their electric field can be neglected. At a certain moment a magnetic field of induction $B$ is switched on, directed along the $z$-axis and filling homogeneously a cylindrical region of radius $R$; thus the induction is zero when the distance $r$ from the $z$-axis is greater than $R$.

a) Let $r_0$ denote the distance of a certain proton from the $z$-axis at the moment the magnetic field is switched on. Prove that the protons satisfying the condition $r_0<R$ acquire the speed $v=Ar_0$, and find the constant $A$.

b) What fraction $k$ of those protons that were initially in the region $r<R$ remain there after the time $T_c$ has passed? $T_c$ is the cyclotron period of the proton, i.e. the time in which a proton makes a full circle in the magnetic field $B$. Assume that the time in which the magnetic field is created is much shorter than $T_c$. Take the initial speed of the protons to be negligibly small. The protons are initially distributed homogeneously and their mean separation is much smaller than $R$. (16 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10

Vaakumkambris on prootonid (mass $M$, laeng $e$), mis paiknevad nii hõredalt, et nende omavaheliste põrgetega ning nende elektriväljaga võib mitte arvestada. Teatud hetkel lülitatakse sisse magnetväli induktsiooniga $B$, mis on $z$-telje suunaline ning täidab homogeenselt silindrilist ruumiosa raadiusega $R$; seega induktsioon on null, kui kaugus $z$-teljest $r$ on suurem kui $R$.

a) Tähistagu $r_0$ teatava prootoni kaugust $z$-teljest magnetvälja sisselülitamise hetkel. Tõestage, et tingimust $r_0<R$ rahuldanud prootonid omandavad kiiruse $v=Ar_0$ ning leidke konstant $A$.

b) Milline osa $k$ neist prootonitest, mis asusid algselt piirkonnas $r<R$, jäävad sinna aja $T_c$ möödumisel? $T_c$ on prootoni tsüklotronperiood, s.o. aeg, mille jooksul prooton teeb magnetväljas $B$ täisringi. Lugeda, et magnetvälja tekitamise aeg on hulga lühem kui $T_c$. Prootonite algkiirus lugeda tühiselt väikseks. Prootonid paiknevad alghetkel homogeenselt ning nende keskmine vahekaugus on hulga väiksem kui $R$. (16 p.)

problems.title: Hunting rifle
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Hunting rifle

A hunting rifle of mass $M=3.5\ \mathrm{kg}$ hangs horizontally on two parallel threads. When fired, the rifle rose by $h=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ because of the recoil. The mass of the bullet is $m=10\ \mathrm{g}$. Determine the speed $v_0$ of the bullet at the moment it leaves the barrel. (6 points)

Problem 2: Water park

In a water park there are a red and a green slide. Their profiles are shown in the figure. Mari starts sliding down the red slide with zero initial speed, while Jüri slides down the green slide with initial speed $v_0=1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Whose speed is greater at the end of the descent, and by what factor, if Jüri weighs $m_j=70\ \mathrm{kg}$ and Mari $m_m=60\ \mathrm{kg}$? One may assume that a constant resistive force $F=20\ \mathrm{N}$ acts on both of them during the descent. (6 points)

problems.title: Parallel fuses
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Fuses

Two fuses rated for currents $I_{M\max}=1\ \mathrm{A}$ and $I_{N\max}=1.2\ \mathrm{A}$, with resistances $R_M=1\ \Omega$ and $R_N=2\ \Omega$ respectively, are connected in parallel. What maximum current can flow through such a system? What would the maximum current be if $I_{N\max}=1.7\ \mathrm{A}$? (8 points)

problems.title: Motorcycle wheelie

Problem 4: Motorcycle

A person of mass $m_1=75\ \mathrm{kg}$ rides a motorcycle whose mass is $m_2=150\ \mathrm{kg}$. The common centre of mass of the rider and the motorcycle is at height $h=0.6\ \mathrm{m}$ above the ground and at a horizontal distance $l=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ from the axle of the rear wheel. At what acceleration does the front wheel lift off the ground? How large must the coefficient of friction between the rear wheel and the ground be for such riding to be possible? (8 points)

problems.title: Sunlight between two peaks
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Mountains

In a valley between two sharp-peaked snowy mountains the sun is at the zenith at noon. The height of the western mountain above the valley floor is $H=2000\ \mathrm{m}$ and the height of the eastern mountain above the valley floor is $h=1500\ \mathrm{m}$. The horizontal distance between the peaks is $l=5\ \mathrm{km}$ and the valley floor is at equal distance from both peaks. How many hours after the direct sunlight disappears does a sudden darkening occur in the valley? Assume that the sky is cloudless. (8 points)

Mägede tippude vaheline kaugus horisontaalsihis on $l=5\ \mathrm{km}$ ja oru põhi on mõlemast tipust võrdsel kaugusel. Mitu tundi pärast otsese päikesevalguse kadumist toimub orus järsk hämardumine? problems.title: Laser and a half-cylinder
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Laser

A half-cylinder made of a transparent material has radius $R$ and the refractive index of the material is $n$. A laser beam is incident perpendicularly on the plane side of the half-cylinder (see figure). Find the maximum distance $d_{\max}$ for which the laser beam still leaves through the cylindrical surface. Within what limits does the distance $l$ (the distance between the point $O$ and the point $A$ where the laser beam crosses the optical axis) vary when $d_{\max}>d>0$? Remark: For small angles one may take $\sin\alpha\approx\tan\alpha\approx\alpha$. It is assumed that $l$ is a monotonic function of $d$. (10 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2004-7-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Laser

Leida maksimaalne kaugus $d_{\max}$, mille korral laserkiir veel väljub silindrilise pinna kaudu. Millistes piirides varieerub kaugus $l$ (punkti $O$ ning laserkiire ja optilise telje lõikepunkti $A$ vahemaa), kui $d_{\max}>d>0$. Märkus: Väikeste nurkade korral võib lugeda $\sin\alpha\approx\tan\alpha\approx\alpha$. Eeldatakse, et $l$ on monotoonne funktsioon $d$-st. (10 p.)

problems.title: Buttons on a rotating disc
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Buttons

The figure shows a top view of two buttons $A$ and $B$ that are connected to each other by a thread of length $l=10\ \mathrm{cm}$. The system lies on a rotating base. The coefficient of friction between the buttons and the base is $\mu$. Another thread is attached to one of the buttons, by which the buttons are held in place (see figure). It is known that the centre of rotation is at distance $a=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ from the block $A$ and both threads are horizontal. What is the distance between the centre of rotation and the button $B$, and what is the mass $m_B$ of the button $B$? The mass of the button $A$ is $m_A=1.0\ \mathrm{g}$ and the threads may be considered weightless. The drawing of the buttons is also given on a separate sheet, which may be used for presenting the solution. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2004-8-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Nööbid

Joonisel on kujutatud pealtvaates kahte nööpi $A$ ja $B$, mis on omavahel ühendatud niidiga, mille pikkus $l=10\ \mathrm{cm}$. Süsteem asub pöörleval alusel. Nööpide ja aluse vaheline hõõrdetegur on $\mu$. Ühe nööbi külge on kinnitatud veel teine niit, mille abil hoitakse nööpe paigal (vt. joon.). On teada, et pöörlemiskese asub klotsist $A$ kaugusel $a=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ ja mõlemad niidid on horisontaalsed. Kui suur on pöörlemiskeskme ja nööbi $B$ vahekaugus ning nööbi $B$ mass $m_B$? Nööbi $A$ mass $m_A=1{,}0\ \mathrm{g}$ ja niidid võib lugeda kaalututeks. Nööpide joonis on ära toodud ka eraldi lehel, mida võib kasutada lahenduse esitamiseks. (12 p.)

problems.title: Interference with two mirrors
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Mirrors

A screen, two mirrors and a source of coherent monochromatic radiation (emitted wavelength $\lambda$) are arranged as shown in the figure. From the light source only the reflected light reaches the screen. The angle between the normals of the mirrors is $2\alpha$. The distance between the contact point of the mirrors and the light source is $a$, and the distance of the light source from the screen is also $a$. It is known that an interference pattern forms near the point $O$, in which the distance between consecutive dark fringes is $d$. Find the wavelength $\lambda$. Assume that $a\gg d$. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2004-9-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Peeglid

Ekraan, kaks peeglit ning koherentse monokromaatilise kiirguse allikas (kiiratav lainepikkus $\lambda$) on paigutatud nii, nagu näidatud joonisel. Valgusallikast jõuab ekraanile vaid peegeldunud valgus. Peeglite normaalide vaheline nurk on $2\alpha$. Peeglite puutepunkti ning valgusallika vaheline kaugus on $a$ ning valgusallika kaugus ekraanist on samuti $a$. On teada, et punkti $O$ lähedusse tekib interferentsimuster, kus järjestikuste tumedate triipude vaheline kaugus on $d$. Leida lainepikkus $\lambda$. Eeldada, et $a\gg d$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Stone
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Stone

A boy is in the gondola of a hot-air balloon rising in a straight line at constant speed $v=4\ \mathrm{m/s}$. At some moment the boy lets a stone fall from the gondola and then throws a ball after the stone, wishing to hit the falling stone with the ball. What is the largest possible time interval between releasing the stone and throwing the ball for this still to be possible? Standing on the ground, the boy could throw the ball vertically upwards to a height of up to $h=20\ \mathrm{m}$. Assume that the balloon is high enough for the stone to be hit by the ball before it falls to the ground. Air resistance is to be taken as negligible. The acceleration of gravity is $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Kivi

Sirgjooneliselt ja jääva kiirusega $v=4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tõusva õhupalli gondlis asub poiss. Mingil hetkel laseb poiss gondlist alla kukkuda kivi ning seejärel viskab ta kivile järgi palli, soovides tabada palliga langevat kivi. Milline võib olla suurim ajavahemik kivi lahtilaskmise ja palli viskamise vahel, et see oleks veel võimalik? Maapinnal seistes suudaks poiss visata palli vertikaalselt üles kuni $h=20\ \mathrm{m}$ kõrgusele. Võib eeldada, et õhupall asub piisavalt kõrgel selleks, et kivi saaks palliga tabada enne maapinnale kukkumist. Õhutakistus lugeda tühiseks. Raskuskiirendus $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (8 p.)

problems.title: Balloon
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Balloon

A closed balloon of volume $V=10\ \mathrm{l}$ was filled with water at temperature $t_0=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. At the same temperature the water was frozen into ice, as a result of which the shell of the balloon stretched out and, throughout the whole freezing process, the water exerted a pressure $p=5\cdot 10^7\ \mathrm{Pa}$ on the balloon.

Find the change of internal energy of the water ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) that was in the balloon, with its sign, and the change of entropy, with its sign. Take the density of ice to be $\rho_j=900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ and the latent heat of fusion at the given pressure to be $\lambda=317\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$. Neglect the compressibility of ice and water. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Balloon

Suletud balloon ruumalaga $V=10\ \mathrm{l}$ oli täidetud veega temperatuuril $t_0=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Samal temperatuuril külmutati vesi jääks, mille tulemusena ballooni kest venis välja ja vesi avaldas kogu jäätumise protsessi käigus balloonile rõhku $p=5\cdot 10^7\ \mathrm{Pa}$.

Leida balloonis olnud vee ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) siseenergia muut koos märgiga ja entroopia muut koos märgiga. Jää tiheduseks võtta $\rho_j=900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ja sulamissoojuseks antud rõhul $\lambda=317\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$. Jää ja vee kokkusurutavust mitte arvestada. (8 p.)

problems.title: Bubbler
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Bubbler

At the bottom of a body of water there is a bubbler --- an air cylinder with a small opening, from which air bubbles of radius $R=0.3\ \mathrm{mm}$ are released at equal time intervals $\Delta t=1\ \mathrm{s}$. When such a small bubble moves in water, a drag force $F=6\pi\eta Rv$ acts on it, where $\eta$ is a coefficient characterising the resistance of the liquid to flow (the viscosity of the liquid; for water its value is $10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N\cdot s/m^2}$) and $v$ is the speed of the bubble. You may assume that the bubble moves all the time at the speed determined by the condition that the resultant of all forces acting on it is zero. The density of water is $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, the acceleration of gravity $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, the atmospheric pressure $p_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. By how many times does the distance between neighbouring bubbles change during the rise from the bottom to the surface, if the depth of the water body is $H=27\ \mathrm{m}$? (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Mullitaja

Veekogu põhjas asub mullitaja --- õhuballoon väikese avausega, millest võrdsete ajavahemike $\Delta t=1\ \mathrm{s}$ järel väljuvad õhumullid raadiusega $R=0{,}3\ \mathrm{mm}$. Taolise mullikese liikumisel vees mõjub sellele takistusjõud $F=6\pi\eta Rv$, kus $\eta$ on vedeliku voolamistakistust iseloomustav tegur (vedeliku viskoossus, vee korral on selle suuruse väärtuseks $10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N\cdot s/m^2}$) ja $v$ on mullikese kiirus. Võite lugeda, et mullikese liikumine toimub kogu aeg kiirusega, mis on määratud tingimusega, et kõigi talle mõjuvate jõudude resultant on null. Vee tihedus $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, raskuskiirendus $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, õhurõhk $p_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Mitu korda muutub vahemaa naabermullikeste vahel tõusul põhjast pinnale, kui veekogu sügavus $H=27\ \mathrm{m}$? (10 p.)

The plates of both capacitors have length $l$, and the distances between the plates are $2d$ and $d$ respectively. Find the angle by which the particle is deflected relative to its initial trajectory when it leaves the upper capacitor in the figure. Assume that this angle is small. (10 points)

problems.title: Slingshot
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Slingshot

Let us consider the construction of a simple slingshot (Estonian "kada" or "ragulka"). An elastic rubber band is stretched between two fixed end points; to shoot, a stone is placed at the middle of the band, the band is pulled taut together with the stone and released. The stone is launched at an angle $\alpha=10^\circ$ to the horizontal. Find how far the shooter must pull the stone back in order to hit a target located at distance $L=25\ \mathrm{m}$ from the slingshot and at the same height as it. What force must the shooter apply to the band for this? The length of the rubber band in the unstretched state is $l=60\ \mathrm{cm}$, which is also the distance between the attachment points of the band. Regard the band as massless, with stiffness $k=50\ \mathrm{N/m}$. The mass of the stone is $m=20\ \mathrm{g}$. Air resistance need not be taken into account. The effect of gravity on the stone while it is being accelerated in the slingshot need not be taken into account. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Kada

Elastne kummipael tõmmatakse kahe fikseeritud otspunkti vahele, laskmiseks asetatakse kivi paela keskele, pael tõmmatakse koos kiviga pingule ja lastakse vabaks. Kivi lastakse lendu horisontaaltasandi suhtes nurga $\alpha=10^\circ$ all. Leidke, kui kaugele peab laskja tõmbama kivi, et tabada märki, mis asub kadast $L=25\ \mathrm{m}$ kaugusel ning sellega samal kõrgusel. Kui suurt jõudu peab ta selleks paelale rakendama? Kummipaela pikkus pingestamata olekus on $l=60\ \mathrm{cm}$, mis on ühtlasi ka paela kinnituspunktide vahekaugus. Pael lugeda kaalutuks ja tema jäikustegur on $k=50\ \mathrm{N/m}$. Suppose that the fingers press on the trigger with a force $F=20\ \mathrm{N}$ (the point of application and the direction of the force are shown in the figure). Oletagem, et sõrmed suruvad päästikule jõuga $F=20\ \mathrm{N}$ (jõu rakenduspunkt ja suund on näidatud joonisel). Kui suure kiirusega väljub veejuga püstolist? problems.title: Moon
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Moon

The reflectance (albedo) is the ratio of the light power reflected from a surface to the light power incident on the surface. The exposure time is the time interval during which the light that has passed through the lens of a camera falls on the film. On a sunny autumn day the optimal exposure time for photographing some object is $t_1=1/8000\ \mathrm{s}$. When photographing the same object at night, when the full moon is shining, the optimal exposure time is $t_2=160\ \mathrm{s}$. When taking both pictures only the exposure time is different. Estimate the average reflectance of the surface of the Moon. The distance of the Moon from the Earth is $R=384\,000\ \mathrm{km}$ and the radius of the Moon is $r=1740\ \mathrm{km}$. To obtain a good-quality picture, the light energy falling on the film must have the same value by day and by night, i.e. in photography the illuminance and the optimal exposure time may be regarded as inversely proportional. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Kuu

Peegeldusteguriks nimetatakse pinnalt peegeldunud ja pinnale langenud valgusvõimsuste suhet. Säriaeg on ajavahemik, mille vältel langeb fotoaparaadis objektiivi läbinud valgus filmilindile. Päikeselisel sügispäeval on mingi objekti pildistamisel optimaalne säriaeg $t_1=1/8000\ \mathrm{s}$. Sama objekti pildistamisel öösel, kui paistab täiskuu, on optimaalne säriaeg $t_2=160\ \mathrm{s}$. Mõlema pildi tegemisel on erinev vaid säriaeg. Hinnake Kuu pinna keskmine peegeldustegur? Kuu kaugus Maast $R=384\,000\ \mathrm{km}$ ja Kuu raadius $r=1740\ \mathrm{km}$. Kvaliteetse pildi saamiseks peab filmile langev valgusenergia päeval ja öösel olema sama väärtusega ehk fotografeerimisel võib valgustatuse ja optimaalse säriaja lugeda pöördvõrdeliseks. (8 p.)

problems.title: Flying electron gun
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Flying electron gun

Jaan Tatikas had come up with yet another flying-machine idea, which he hurried to put into practice at once. Namely, he built a platform of logs, under which he attached an electron gun broken out of a television set, together with the necessary electronics and a battery. The voltage accelerating the electrons is $U$, the current in the electron beam is $I$. Find how large a lifting force $F$ this device can produce. What condition should $U$ and $I$ satisfy for such a flying machine to be able to lift the inventor into the air? Is this realistic (in television sets $U\approx 30\ \mathrm{kV}$, $I\approx 100\ \mu\mathrm{A}$)? Relativistic effects need not be taken into account; the initial speed of the electron at the cathode is $0$. Assume that the beam forms at all (do not take the presence of air into account). The mass of Tatikas together with the platform and the device is $m_T\approx 150\ \mathrm{kg}$, the acceleration of gravity $g\approx 9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. The ratio of the charge and mass of the electron is $k=e/m_e\approx 1.76\cdot 10^{11}\ \mathrm{C/kg}$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Lendav elektronkahur

Jaan Tatikal tuli järjekordne lennumasinaidee, mida ta kohe realiseerima tõttas. Ta nimelt ehitas palkidest platvormi, mille alla kinnitas telerist välja lõhutud elektronkahuri koos vajaliku elektroonika ja akuga. Elektrone kiirendav pinge on $U$, voolutugevus elektronkiires $I$. Leidke, kui suurt tõstejõudu $F$ suudab see seade tekitada. Missugust tingimust peaksid $U$ ja $I$ rahuldama, et taoline lennumasin suudaks leiduri õhku tõsta? Kas see on ka realistlik (televiisorites $U\approx 30\ \mathrm{kV}$, $I\approx 100\ \mu\mathrm{A}$)? Relativistlikke efekte pole vaja arvestada; elektroni algkiirus katoodi juures on $0$. Eeldage, et kiir üldse moodustub (õhu olemasoluga ärge arvestage). Tatika mass koos platvormi ja seadmega on $m_T\approx 150\ \mathrm{kg}$, raskuskiirendus $g\approx 9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Elektroni laengu ja massi suhe $k=e/m_e\approx 1{,}76\cdot 10^{11}\ \mathrm{C/kg}$. (10 p.)

Graafikul on toodud toatemperatuuri sõltuvus ajast. Leidke toatemperatuur pika aja möödumisel. Protsessi vältel välistingimused ei muutunud. problems.title: Thermal radiation
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Thermal radiation

When storing liquefied gases, much attention has to be paid to the thermal insulation of the vessel. A substantial part of the heat exchange is due to thermal radiation. Suppose that the vessel has double walls, whose radiated power per unit area is $\varepsilon\sigma T^4$, where the Stefan--Boltzmann constant is $\sigma=5.67\times 10^{-8}\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ and the emissivity $\varepsilon$ of the walls is taken to be independent of temperature and equal to $0.1$. The temperature of the inner wall in contact with liquid nitrogen is $T_\mathrm{s}=77\ \mathrm{K}$, and the temperature of the outer wall in contact with room air is $T_\mathrm{v}=293\ \mathrm{K}$.

a) Find the heat flow due to thermal radiation through a wall area of $1\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Note: Kirchhoff's law holds --- the absorptivity of a body, which shows what fraction of the radiation falling on the surface of the substance is absorbed, is always equal to its emissivity $\varepsilon$.

b) To reduce the heat flow, $N$ thin screens, whose surface is covered with the same material as the walls of the vessel, are placed between the inner and outer walls. By how many times does the heat flow decrease as a result? Justify your answer.

(Total 12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Soojuskiirgus

Veeldatud gaaside säilitamisel on tarvis palju tähelepanu pöörata anuma soojusisolatsioonile. Olulise osa soojusvahetusest moodustab soojuskiirgus. Oletagem, et anumal on kahekordsed seinad, mille kiirgusvõimsus pinnaühiku kohta on $\varepsilon\sigma T^4$, kus Stefan-Boltzmanni konstant $\sigma=5{,}67\times 10^{-8}\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ ja seinte kiirgamisvõime $\varepsilon$ loeme temperatuurist sõltumatuks ja võrdseks $0{,}1$-ga. Vedela lämmastikuga kokkupuutes oleva siseseina temperatuur on $T_\mathrm{s}=77\ \mathrm{K}$, toaõhuga kokkupuutes oleva välisseina temperatuur aga $T_\mathrm{v}=293\ \mathrm{K}$.

a) Leidke soojuskiirgusest tingitud soojusvoog läbi $1\ \mathrm{cm^2}$ suuruse seinapinna. Märkus: kehtib Kirchoffi seadus --- keha neelamisvõime, mis näitab, kui suur osa aine pinnale langevast kiirgusest neeldub, on alati võrdne tema kiirgamisvõimega $\varepsilon$.

b) Soojusvoo vähendamiseks asetatakse sise- ja välisseina vahele $N$ õhukest ekraani, mille pind on kaetud samasuguse materjaliga nagu anuma seinad. Mitu korda väheneb selle tulemusena soojusvoog? Põhjendage vastust.

(Kokku 12 p.)

problems.title: Flash
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Flash

An optical system consists of two concave mirrors and a convex lens (see fig.) whose optical principal axes coincide. A light pulse of circular cross-section enters the system along the optical axis, and the axis of the light beam coincides with it. The radii of curvature of the mirrors are $R_1=8\ \mathrm{m}$ and $R_2=4\ \mathrm{m}$ and the distance between the mirrors is $L=6\ \mathrm{m}$. The diameters of the mirrors are $d_1=160\ \mathrm{mm}$ and $d_2=96\ \mathrm{mm}$. The diameter of the beam is $D=192\ \mathrm{mm}$. The diameter of the lens is larger than that of the light beam. In the centre of the larger mirror there is a hole of diameter $d_0=1\ \mathrm{mm}$. Draw the time course of the light intensity at the focus $f$ of the convex lens. Assume that the duration of the pulse arriving at the system is $\tau\ll L/c$. The speed of light is $c=3\times 10^8\ \mathrm{m/s}$. (12 points)

problems.title: Heating glass
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Heating glass

The surface of an electrically heated glass used for heating rooms is covered with a thin light-transmitting electrically conducting layer, to whose opposite edges an electric voltage is applied (the current flows along the surface of the glass). How are the heat powers $P_H$ and $P_V$ released by a rectangular window made of such glass related when the same voltage is applied between the horizontal edges ($P_H$) and between the vertical edges ($P_V$) of the glass, respectively? The horizontal dimension of the window is $a=0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ and the vertical dimension is $b=1\ \mathrm{m}$. (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Kütteklaas

Ruumide soojendamiseks kasutatava elektriliselt köetava klaasi pind on kaetud õhukese valgust läbilaskva elektrit juhtiva kihiga, mille vastasservadele rakendatakse elektriline pinge (vool kulgeb mööda klaasi pinda). Kuidas suhtuvad sellisest klaasist valmistatud ristkülikukujuliselt aknalt eralduvad soojusvõimsused $P_H$ ja $P_V$ sama pinge rakendamisel vastavalt klaasi horisontaalsete ($P_H$) ja vertikaalsete ($P_V$) servade vahel? Akna horisontaalmõõde $a=0{,}5\ \mathrm{m}$ ja vertikaalmõõde $b=1\ \mathrm{m}$. (6 p.)

problems.title: Venus
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Venus

Let us regard the orbits of the Earth and Venus around the Sun as circular. The planets orbit the Sun in the same direction, and the maximum elongation of Venus (the angle between Venus and the Sun as seen from the Earth) is 46 degrees.

a) Find the ratio of the radii of the orbits of Venus and the Earth. (4 points)

b) How many days pass between successive maximum elongations? (4 points)

Hint: According to Kepler's law, the squares of the orbital periods of celestial bodies are proportional to the cubes of the radii of the respective orbits.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Veenus

Lugegem Maa ja Veenuse orbiidid ümber Päikese ringikujulisteks. Planeedid tiirlevad ümber Päikese samas suunas ja Veenuse maksimaalne eemaldumus (nurk Veenuse ja Päikese vahel Maalt vaadates) on 46 kraadi.

a) Leidke Veenuse ja Maa orbiitide raadiuste suhe. (4 p.)

b) Mitu päeva jääb järjestikuste maksimaalsete eemaldumuste vahele? (4 p.)

Juhtnöör: Kepleri seaduse kohaselt on taevakehade tiirlemisperioodide ruudud võrdelised vastavate orbiitide raadiuste kuupidega.

problems.title: Wedge
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Wedge

A thin glass plate (refractive index of the glass $n=1.5$) is placed roughly perpendicular to the path of a laser beam. As a result, the image of the laser beam on a screen at a distance $L=2\ \mathrm{m}$ is displaced by $d=5\ \mathrm{mm}$. It is concluded that the plate is slightly wedge-shaped. Find the apex angle $\alpha$ of this wedge.

Hint: For small angles $\varphi$, $\sin\varphi\approx\tan\varphi\approx\varphi$. (8 points)

Laserikiire teele asetatakse enam-vähem risti õhuke klaasplaat (klaasi murdumisnäitaja $n=1{,}5$). Selle tulemusena nihkub $L=2\ \mathrm{m}$ kaugusel ekraanil olev laserikiire kujutis $d=5\ \mathrm{mm}$ võrra. Järeldatakse, et plaat on kergelt kiilukujuline. Leidke selle kiilu tipunurk $\alpha$.

Juhtnöör: Väikeste nurkade $\varphi$ puhul $\sin\varphi\approx\tan\varphi\approx\varphi$. (8 p.)

problems.title: Flywheel
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Flywheel

A flywheel of radius $R$ rotates with angular velocity $\omega$. For simplicity, the flywheel may be regarded as a thin ring (the axis of rotation coincides with the axis of the ring).

a) What is the energy storage density $w$ (kinetic energy per unit mass) in the flywheel? (4 points)

b) The flywheel is made of carbon-fibre-reinforced polymer with tensile strength $\sigma_{\max}=2.4\cdot 10^9\ \mathrm{Pa}$ and density $\rho=1500\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Estimate the maximum possible value of the energy storage density in such a flywheel (giving a numerical answer). (6 points)

Hint: The tensile strength is the maximum force per unit cross-sectional area that the given material can withstand without breaking.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Hooratas

Hooratas raadiusega $R$ pöörleb nurkkiirusega $\omega$. Lihtsuse huvides võib hooratast vaadelda peenikese rõngana (pöörlemistelg ühtib rõnga teljega).

a) Milline on energia salvestustihedus $w$ (kineetiline energia massiühiku kohta) hoorattas? (4 p.)

b) Hooratas on valmistatud süsinikkiuga armeeritud polümeerist, mille tõmbetugevus $\sigma_{\max}=2{,}4\cdot 10^9\ \mathrm{Pa}$ ja tihedus $\rho=1500\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Hinnake energia salvestustiheduse maksimaalselt võimalikku väärtust sellises hoorattas (andes numbrilise vastuse). (6 p.)

Juhtnöör: Tõmbetugevus on maksimaalne jõud ristlõike pindala kohta, mida antud materjal talub ilma purunemata.

There are rivers in the world where, because of the tides, the water moves now in one direction, now in the other. Let us consider ship traffic on such a river. Figure 1 shows the water velocity as a function of the time of day. The velocity of the water is considered positive when it is directed from point $A$ towards point $B$. Find the optimal timetable (with the shortest travel times) for a cargo ship to travel regularly once a day from point $A$ to point $B$ and back. The distance between these points along the river is $L=20\ \mathrm{km}$, and the speed of the ship in still water is $v=4\ \mathrm{km/h}$. (10 points)

A certain amount of heat was given to the hydrogen, as a result of which the weight moved upwards by $d_1=5.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. After a long time it was observed that the weight had moved further. Problem 5: Underwater light

Is a point light source hanging above a swimming pool, observed from the bottom of the pool, brighter when the pool is empty of water, or when it is filled with water and the distance from the eye to the water surface equals the height of the light source above the water surface? By what factor? A fraction $r=2\%$ of the light is reflected back from the water surface, the refractive index of water is $n=1.33$, and absorption in water is negligible. The brightness of the source is proportional to the energy of the light entering the pupil of the eye; we take the diameter of the pupil to be the same in all observing conditions and small compared with the depth of the observer. problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Veealune valgus

Kas basseini kohal rippuv punktvalgusallikas, mida vaadeldakse basseini põhjast, on heledam siis, kui bassein on veest tühi, või siis, kui ta on veega täidetud ja kaugus silmast veepinnani võrdub valgusallika kõrgusega veepinna kohal? Mitu korda? Veepinnalt peegeldub tagasi $r=2\%$ valgust, vee murdumisnäitaja on $n=1{,}33$ ja neeldumine vees on tühine. Allika heledus on võrdeline silmaavasse sattuva valguse energiaga, silmaava läbimõõdu loeme samaks kõigis vaatlustingimustes ja väikeseks võrreldes vaatleja sügavusega. (8 p.)

problems.title: Boiling water
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Boiling water

Mari boiled tea for Miku, but this time the water started to boil only at $t_0=105\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, although the room was at normal pressure. What is the matter? As is known, water starts to boil when the pressure of saturated water vapour becomes equal to the air pressure and bubbles filled with saturated vapour can start to expand throughout the vessel; usually there are enough solid particles in the water on which sufficiently large bubbles form, so that surface tension need not be taken into account. But assuming that this time the water was exceptionally pure, estimate the largest possible radius of the bubbles before boiling. The surface tension of water at the boiling temperature may be taken as $\sigma=58\cdot 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N/m}$, and in a linear approximation take into account that raising the temperature by one degree increases the saturated water-vapour pressure by $\Delta p=3.5\ \mathrm{kPa}$ (near the boiling temperature). (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Vee keemine

Mari keetis Mikule teed, aga vesi läks seekord keema alles $t_0=105\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ juures, kuigi toas oli normaalrõhk. Milles asi? Teatavasti hakkab vesi keema siis, kui küllastunud veeauru rõhk saab võrdseks õhurõhuga ning kogu anuma ulatuses saavad hakata paisuma küllastunud auruga täidetud mullid; tavaliselt on vees küllaldaselt tahkeid osakesi, millele tekivad piisavalt suured mullid, nii et pindpinevusega pole tarvis arvestada. Oletades aga, et seekord oli vesi haruldaselt puhas, hinnake, missugune oli mullide suurim võimalik raadius enne keemist. Vee pindpinevuseks keemistemperatuuril võib võtta $\sigma=58\cdot 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N/m}$ ning lineaarses lähenduses arvestada, et temperatuuri tõstmisel ühe kraadi võrra suureneb küllastunud veeauru rõhk $\Delta p=3{,}5\ \mathrm{kPa}$ võrra (keemistemperatuuri läheduses). (10 p.)

problems.title: U-tube
problems.problem:
Problem 8: U-tube

Toomas is playing with a U-tube made of a transparent garden hose. Since this U-tube is not made of glass, he bends one side by an angle $\alpha$ and the other by $\beta$ (see the figure). Is the oscillation frequency of the liquid level now greater or smaller, and by what factor?

Note: In a vertical U-tube the frequency of oscillation of the liquid level is $f=\dfrac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\dfrac{2S\rho g}{m}}$, where $S$ is the cross-sectional area of the tube, $\rho$ is the density of the liquid and $m$ is the mass of the liquid in the tube. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2008-8-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: V-toru

Toomas mängib läbipaistvast aiavoolikust tehtud U-toruga. Et seekordne U-toru polegi klaasist, painutab ta üht poolt nurga $\alpha$ ning teist $\beta$ võrra (vt. joonist). Kas vedelikutaseme võnkesagedus on nüüd suurem või väiksem, mitu korda?

Märkus: Vertikaalses U-torus on vedelikutaseme võnkumise sagedus $f=\dfrac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\dfrac{2S\rho g}{m}}$, kus $S$ on toru ristlõikepindala, $\rho$ vedeliku tihedus ning $m$ torus oleva vedeliku mass. (12 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2008-8-fig1.png

problems.title: Rod
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Rod

A thin homogeneous rod rests with one end against the floor (the coefficient of friction between the end of the rod and the floor is $\mu$) and with its side against a smooth horizontal cylinder (the coefficient of friction is negligibly small), see the figure. The cylinder is fixed motionless to the floor, the rod is perpendicular to the axis of the cylinder and makes an angle $\alpha$ with the floor. For what length $l$ of the rod will the rod remain in such a position? (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2008-9-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Varras

Peenike homogeenne varras toetub ühe otsaga vastu põrandat (hõõrdetegur varda otsa ja põranda vahel on $\mu$) ning küljega vastu libedat horisontaalset silindrit (hõõrdetegur on tühiselt väike), vt. joonist. Silinder on liikumatult kinnitatud põranda külge, varras on risti silindri teljega ning moodustab põrandaga nurga $\alpha$. Millise varda pikkuse $l$ korral jääb varras sellisesse asendisse püsima? (12 p.)

problems.title: Coil
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Coil

On a smooth glass rod a solenoid of length $\ell$, with $N$ turns and cross-sectional area $S$, has been tightly wound from soft wire. A constant current $I$ is maintained in it. What force $F$ would have to be applied to the ends of the coil along the core to stretch it slightly longer, if the assumption held that on stretching the distances between all neighbouring turns increase equally. You may assume that the magnetic permeability of the glass is $\mu=1$.

Hint: In the core of a dense solenoid there is a homogeneous magnetic induction $B=\mu_0 IN/\ell$. (14 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Pool

Libedale klaaspulgale on pehmest traadist tihedasti keritud solenoid pikkusega $\ell$, keerdude arvuga $N$ ja ristlõikepindalaga $S$. Selles hoitakse konstantset voolu tugevusega $I$. Millist jõudu $F$ oleks vaja rakendada pooli otstele südamiku sihis, et venitada seda pisutki pikemaks, kui kehtiks eeldus, et venitamisel suurenevad kõigi naaberkeerdude vahekaugused võrdselt. Võite lugeda, et klaasi magnetiline läbitavus $\mu=1$.

Juhtnöör: Tiheda solenoidi südamikus on homogeenne magnetinduktsioon $B=\mu_0 IN/\ell$. (14 p.)

problems.title: Blunt shears
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Blunt shears

Juku set out to cut a thick dry branch off an apple tree with hedge shears. But the shears had become blunt long ago and were of no use. What is more, while the shears were being squeezed together, the branch even started to slip between the blades. The slipping stopped at the moment when the angle between the blades had decreased to $\alpha$. What was the coefficient of friction between the branch and the blunt blade? (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Nürinenud käärid

Juku asus hekikääridega õunapuult jämedat kuivanud oksa lõikama. Et aga käärid olid juba ammu nürinenud, polnud neist mingit abi. Enamgi veel, oks hakkas kääride kokkuvajutamise ajal terade vahel lausa libisema. Libisemine peatus hetkel, mil terade vaheline nurk oli kahanenud $\alpha$-ni. Kui suur oli hõõrdetegur oksa ja nürinenud lõiketera vahel? (6 p.)

problems.title: Box in a van
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Box in a van

A box of mass $m=15\ \mathrm{kg}$ is attached to the rear wall of a van by a string. Find the minimum possible value of the tension of the string during sudden braking, when the van travelling at speed $v_0=45\ \mathrm{km/h}$ comes to rest in time $t=5\ \mathrm{s}$. The coefficient of friction between the base of the box and the floor of the van is $\mu=0.2$, the angle between the string and the rear wall of the van is $\alpha=45^\circ$. Assume that the braking was uniform and the box stayed in place all the time. (8 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-2-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Kast kaubikus

Kast massiga $m=15\ \mathrm{kg}$ on kinnitatud kaubiku tagaseina külge nööriga. Leida nööri pinge minimaalne võimalik väärtus äkkpidurduse ajal, kui kiirusega $v_0=45\ \mathrm{km/h}$ sõitev kaubik jääb seisma ajaga $t=5\ \mathrm{s}$. Hõõrdetegur kasti aluse ja kaubiku põranda vahel $\mu=0{,}2$, nurk nööri ja kaubiku tagaseina vahel $\alpha=45^\circ$. Lugeda, et pidurdamine oli ühtlane ja kast püsis kogu aeg paigal. (8 p.)
