problems.title: Train in a tunnel
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Train in a tunnel

A train travelled at speed $v=54\ \mathrm{km/h}$ through a long horizontal cylindrical tunnel. By how much did the temperature of the air in the tunnel rise? The diameter of the tunnel is $d=5\ \mathrm{m}$. While passing through the tunnel, the electric motor of the train consumed power $P=800\ \mathrm{kW}$. The molar mass of air is $M=29\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, the air pressure in the tunnel is $p=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$ and the initial temperature is $t_0=17\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Treat air as a diatomic ideal gas.

Note. The internal energy per molecule of a diatomic gas is $5/3$ times that of a monatomic gas at the same temperature. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Rong tunnelis

Rong liikus kiirusega $v=54\ \mathrm{km/h}$ läbi pika horisontaalse silindrikujulise tunneli. Kui palju tõusis tunnelis asuva õhu temperatuur? Tunneli läbimõõt $d=5\ \mathrm{m}$. Rongi elektrimootor tarbis tunnelit läbides võimsust $P=800\ \mathrm{kW}$. Õhu molaarmass on $M=29\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, õhurõhk tunnelis $p=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$ ja algtemperatuur $t_0=17\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Õhk lugeda kaheaatomiliseks ideaalseks gaasiks.

Märkus. Kaheaatomilise gaasi siseenergia ühe molekuli kohta on $5/3$ korda suurem kui samal temperatuuril oleval üheaatomilisel gaasil. (8 p.)

problems.title: GPS
problems.problem:
Problem 5: GPS

A fitness runner uses a GPS device to record the results of a running workout. The GPS device determines the exact position of the runner every 15 seconds, from which it calculates and records the average speed over the last 15 seconds. The GPS shows the results on a graph as points connected by straight line segments. The runner noticed that a shoelace had come undone. He stopped, tied it up, and thanks to the short rest continued running at a somewhat higher speed, see the accompanying graph shown by the GPS. How long did the stop last? The time spent on braking and on accelerating after the rest may be taken as negligible; the running speed was constant both before and after the stop. (10 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-5-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: GPS

Tervisesportlane kasutab GPS seadet oma jooksutreeningu tulemuste salvestamiseks. Tema GPS seade määrab iga 15 sekundi järel jooksja täpse asukoha, mille põhjal arvutab ja salvestab GPS seade viimase 15 sekundi keskmise kiiruse. GPS esitab saadud tulemused graafikul punktidena, mis on ühendatud sirglõikude abil. Jooksja märkas, et ketsipael oli lahti läinud. Ta peatus, sidus selle kinni ning tänu väikesele puhkusele jätkas jooksu juba natuke suurema kiirusega, vt juuresolevat GPS-i esitatud graafikut. Kui kaua kestis peatus? Pidurdumiseks ning puhkusjärgselt kiirendamiseks kulunud aeg lugeda tühiseks; jooksu kiirus oli konstantne nii enne peatust kui ka pärast seda. (10 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-5-fig1.png

problems.title: Open window
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Open window

A room is heated by an electric radiator of power $P=1\ \mathrm{kW}$. The outside temperature is $t_0=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, and a uniform temperature $t_1=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is maintained in the room. Now a ventilation window is opened and outdoor air enters the room at a rate $v=20$ litres per second. What will the room temperature become? The air may be treated as an ideal gas whose heat capacity at constant pressure per mole is $c_P=\frac{7}{2}R$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Õhuaken

Tuba köetakse elektriradiaatoriga, mille võimsus $P=1\ \mathrm{kW}$. Välistemperatuur on $t_0=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, toas püsib ühtlane temperatuur $t_1=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Nüüd avatakse õhuaken ning õueõhku tuleb tuppa kiirusega $v=20$ liitrit sekundis. Milliseks kujuneb toatemperatuur? Õhu võib lugeda ideaalseks gaasiks, mille soojusmahtuvus konstantsel rõhul ühe mooli kohta on $c_P=\frac{7}{2}R$. (10 p.)

problems.title: Confocal microscope
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Confocal microscope

To obtain better spatial resolution than with ordinary microscopes, confocal microscopes are used. The accompanying figure shows the main elements of a confocal microscope: the objective, the lenses $\mathrm{L}_1$ and $\mathrm{L}_2$, and a small circular aperture located in their common focal plane. The figure also shows the path of rays from a small object under study located on the optical axis. Rays coming from objects farther from or closer to the objective than its focal plane mostly do not pass through the aperture but are absorbed at its edges. As a side effect, the field of view narrows. How far from the optical axis can an object lying in the focal plane of the objective be and still be visible? The focal lengths of the lenses $\mathrm{L}_1$, $\mathrm{L}_2$ and the objective are $f_1$, $f_2$ and $f_{\mathrm{obj}}$ respectively, the diameter of the aperture is $d$. (10 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-7-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Konfokaalne mikroskoop

Harilikest mikroskoopidest parema ruumilise lahutuse saamiseks kasutatakse konfokaalseid mikroskoope. Juuresoleval joonisel on kujutatud konfokaalse mikroskoobi põhielemendid: objektiiv, läätsed $\mathrm{L}_1$ ja $\mathrm{L}_2$ ning nende ühises fokaaltasandis asuv väike ringikujuline ava. Joonisel on samuti esitatud optilisel peateljel asuvast väikesest uuritavast esemest lähtuvate kiirte käik. Objektiivi fokaaltasandist kaugemal ja lähemal olevatest objektidest lähtuvad kiired ei läbi enamuses ava, vaid neelduvad ava servadel. Kõrvalnähtusena vaateväli kitseneb. Kui kaugel optilisest peateljest võib olla objektiivi fokaaltasandis olev ese, et ta oleks veel nähtav? Läätsede $\mathrm{L}_1$, $\mathrm{L}_2$ ja objektiivi fookuskaugused on vastavalt $f_1$, $f_2$ ja $f_{\mathrm{obj}}$, ava läbimõõt $d$. (10 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-7-fig1.png

problems.title: Motorboat
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Motorboat

A motorboat travels from point A on one bank of a river to point B on the other bank. The speed of the boat is $u=7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. (12 points in total)

a) The figure shows the water waves produced by the boat. What is the flow speed of the river? (6 points)

b) It is known that when the depth of the water is $h$, waves propagate with speed $w=\sqrt{gh}$, where $g$ is the acceleration of free fall. How deep is the river? (6 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2009-8-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Kaater

Mootorpaat sõidab jõe ühelt kaldalt punktist A teisele kaldale punkti B. Paadi kiirus on $u=7\ \mathrm{m/s}$. (Kokku 12 p.)

a) Joonisel on näidatud paadi tekitatud veelained. Milline on jõe voolukiirus? (6 p.)

b) On teada, et kui vee sügavus on $h$, siis lained levivad kiirusega $w=\sqrt{gh}$, kus $g$ on vabalangemise kiirendus. Kui sügav on jõgi? (6 p.)

problems.title: Space debris
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Space debris

Two identical electrically charged balls, connected by an ideal string, float freely in space. The charge of each ball is $q$ and its mass is $M$, the length of the string is $l$. Suddenly a piece of space debris of mass $m$ and speed $v$ flies perpendicular to the string and hits its midpoint, and sticks to the string. What is the smallest distance $d$ to which the balls approach each other? Assume that the diameters of the balls are smaller than the sought distance $d$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Kosmoseprügi

Kaks ühesugust elektriliselt laetud kuuli, mis on ühendatud ideaalse nööriga, hõljuvad vabalt kosmoses. Kummagi kera laeng on $q$ ja mass $M$, nööri pikkus on $l$. Ootamatult lendab nööriga risti selle keskkoha pihta kosmoseprügi tükk massiga $m$ ja kiirusega $v$ ning jääb nööri külge kinni. Millisele vähimale kaugusele $d$ lähenevad teineteisele kuulid? Eeldada, et kuulikeste diameetrid on väiksemad kui otsitav kaugus $d$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Art exhibition
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Art exhibition

The hall of an art exhibition is a large room with white walls, illuminated with monochromatic green light (wavelength $\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$). The room has a floor of smooth glass; the lower surface of the glass is painted black, and the upper surface is covered with a thin transparent colourless film. A visitor standing in the middle of the room sees bright and dark circular bands on the floor around them, and the visitor is at the centre of these circles, regardless of where exactly they stand. The visitor investigates more closely: crouches and looks far away, then tries to look straight down. At most they manage to count $N=20$ bright bands. How thick is the film covering the glass? The refractive index of the glass is $n_0=1.6$, that of the film covering it is $n_1=1.4$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Kunstinäitus

Kunstinäituse saal kujutab endast valgete seintega suurt tuba, mida valgustatakse monokromaatilise rohelise valgusega (lainepikkus $\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$). Sellel toal on siledast klaasist põrand; klaasi alumine pind on värvitud mustaks, ülemine pind on aga kaetud õhukese läbipaistva värvitu kilega. Keset tuba seisev näitusekülastaja näeb enda ümber põrandal heledaid ja tumedaid ringikujulisi vööte, kusjuures ta ise asub nende ringide keskpunktis — sõltumata sellest, kus kohas ta parajasti seisab. Näitusekülastaja uurib asja lähemalt: kükitab ja vaatab kaugele, seejärel püüab vaadata otse alla. Maksimaalselt õnnestub tal loendada $N=20$ heledat vööti. Kui paks on klaasi kattev kile? Klaasi murdumisnäitaja $n_0=1{,}6$, seda katva kile oma $n_1=1{,}4$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Bridge
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Bridge

A convex bridge runs across a river of width $l=100\ \mathrm{m}$; at its middle the road is $h=5\ \mathrm{m}$ higher than the level of the river bank. The profile of the bridge is an arc of a circle. A car of mass $m=1000\ \mathrm{kg}$ crosses the bridge at constant speed $v=60\ \mathrm{km/h}$. With what force does the car press on the middle of the bridge? At what speed does the contact between the wheels and the road begin to disappear? (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Sild

Risti üle $l=100\ \mathrm{m}$ laiuse jõe kulgeb kumer sild, mille keskel on autotee $h=5\ \mathrm{m}$ võrra kõrgemal kaldapealsest tasemest. Silla profiiliks on ringjoone kaar. Auto massiga $m=1000\ \mathrm{kg}$ ületab silla muutumatu kiirusega $v=60\ \mathrm{km/h}$. Kui suure jõuga rõhub auto silla keskkohta? Kui suure kiiruse juures hakkab kaduma kontakt rataste ja tee vahel? (6 p.)

problems.title: Distiller
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Distiller

A distiller produces $V=2$ litres of pure water per hour. The incoming steam and the condensed water are at the same temperature. Of the heat released when the steam condenses, $\eta=95\ \%$ is used to heat the cooling water. The cooling system is a long pipe in which the cooling water flows. The cross-sectional area of the pipe is $S=0.8\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. The temperatures of the cooling water entering and leaving the distiller differ by $\Delta T=30\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. How fast must the water flow in the cooling system? The latent heat of vaporisation of water is $L=2300\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$, the specific heat of water is $c=4.2\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ and the density of water is $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Destillaator

Destillaator toodab tunnis $V=2$ liitrit puhast vett. Sisenev aur ja kondenseerunud vesi on samal temperatuuril. Auru kondenseerumisel vabanenud soojusest kulub $\eta=95\ \%$ jahutusvee soojendamiseks. Jahutussüsteem kujutab endast pikka toru, milles voolab jahutusvesi. Toru ristlõikepindala on $S=0{,}8\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Destillaatorisse siseneva ja sealt väljuva jahutusvee temperatuurid erinevad $\Delta T=30\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ võrra. Kui kiiresti peab vesi voolama jahutussüsteemis? Vee aurustumissoojus $L=2300\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$, vee erisoojus $c=4{,}2\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ ja vee tihedus $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. (6 p.)

Fikseeritud telgedega hammasrattad raadiustega $r_1$ ja $r_2$ hambuvad ja on ühendatud venimatu nööriga, mis on mõlemale puutujaks. Esimest ratast pööratakse jõumomendiga $M$. Kui suur on nööri pinge $T$? (8 p.)

problems.title: Pipe
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Pipe

A rectangular block is placed in equilibrium on a rough horizontally fixed pipe (radius $R$). Find the thickness $L$ of the block for which the position of the block on the pipe is stable.

Note. The relations $\sin\alpha\approx\alpha$ and $\cos\alpha\approx 1-\alpha^2/2$, valid for small angles, where the angles are in radians, may be useful. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Toru

Karedale horisontaalselt kinnitatud torule (raadius $R$) on asetatud tasakaalu risttahukakujuline pruss. Leidke prussi paksus $L$, mille korral prussi asend torul on stabiilne.

Märkus. Võivad olla kasulikud väikeste nurkade korral kehtivad võrdused $\sin\alpha\approx\alpha$ ja $\cos\alpha\approx 1-\alpha^2/2$, kus nurgad on radiaanides. (8 p.)

problems.title: Air hockey
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Air hockey

A light puck of radius $r=1\ \mathrm{cm}$ made of dry ice (i.e. solid carbon dioxide) is placed on a plate of a good heat conductor; the puck is pressed from above with a force $F=10\ \mathrm{N}$. At what minimum temperature of the base does the puck hover on a gas cushion produced by the sublimating carbon dioxide? Take the temperature of the base to be uniform and equal to that of the layer of substance in direct contact with it. The air pressure is $P_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$ and the dependence of the vapour pressure of dry ice on temperature is shown in the graph. (10 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2010-6-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Õhuhoki

Heast soojusjuhist plaadile asetatakse kuivast jääst (st tahkest süsihappegaasist) kerge seib raadiusega $r=1\ \mathrm{cm}$; seibi surutakse pealt jõuga $F=10\ \mathrm{N}$. Millise minimaalse aluse temperatuuri juures hõljub seib sublimeeruva süsihappegaasi tekitatud gaasipadjal? Aluse temperatuur lugege ühtlaseks ja samaks temaga vahetus kontaktis oleva ainekihiga. Õhurõhk $P_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$ ja kuiva jää aururõhu sõltuvus temperatuurist on kujutatud graafikul. (10 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2010-6-fig1.png

problems.title: Satellites
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Satellites

In February 2009, American and Russian satellites collided over Siberia at an altitude of 780 kilometres. Bearing in mind that thousands of satellites already orbit the Earth and that, therefore, it is not possible to coordinate all their orbits with each other, estimate how many years apart such random collisions occur on average. In your solution use the following estimates and approximations: the number of near-Earth satellites is $N=2500$; the orbits lie in the range of altitudes above the Earth's surface from $h_1=200\ \mathrm{km}$ to $h_2=2000\ \mathrm{km}$, and the satellites are distributed in this layer with uniform spatial density; the cross-sectional area of a typical satellite is $S=10\ \mathrm{m^2}$. The radius of the Earth is $R_{\mathrm{Maa}}=6400\ \mathrm{km}$, the acceleration of gravity at the surface is $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (12 points)

The voltage across the rectifier diode is negligible, but across each light-emitting diode it is $U_d=3\ \mathrm{V}$. What resistance $R$ and maximum power rating $N$ should the resistor have, if the light-emitting diodes tolerate a current of up to $I=20\ \mathrm{mA}$? What capacitance $C$ of the capacitor ensures that the pulsation of the current stays within $\alpha=5\%$? The frequency of the mains voltage is $f=50\ \mathrm{Hz}$ and its amplitude is $U_0=311\ \mathrm{V}$. (12 points)

problems.title: Water
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Water

In an open thermos flask the water is at temperature $t_0=100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. $1\%$ of it evaporates. Estimate by how much the temperature $t$ of the water remaining in the thermos changes. The specific heat of water is $c_v=4.2\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, the specific heat of water vapour is $c_a=1.9\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, and the heat of vaporisation of water at $100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is $L=2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. Assume that there are no heat losses through the walls of the thermos. (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Vesi

Vee erisoojus $c_v=4{,}2\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, veeauru erisoojus $c_a=1{,}9\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ ning vee aurustumissoojus temperatuuril $100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ on $L=2{,}26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. A small ring of mass $m$ can slide along a very long and negligibly light rod attached to a wall by a hinge. Initially the ring is at distance $l$ from the hinge and the rod is horizontal. problems.title: Water pipe
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Water pipe

Two horizontal pipes of different diameters are joined end to end so that their axes coincide. Water flows along the first pipe with speed $v_1$. A small vertical tube is attached to each pipe; the heights of the liquid columns in them are $h_1$ and $h_2$ respectively (measured from the axis of the pipe). Find the ratio of the diameters of the horizontal pipes. Neglect friction.

Hint. For a liquid flowing horizontally, Bernoulli's law holds in the form $\frac{\rho v^2}{2}+p=\mathrm{const}$, where $p$ is the hydrostatic pressure, $\rho$ the density of the liquid and $v$ the speed of the liquid. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Veetoru

Kaks erineva diameetriga horisontaalset toru on otsapidi kokku ühendatud nii, et nende teljed ühtivad. Mööda esimest toru voolab vesi kiirusega $v_1$. Kummagi veetoru külge on ühendatud väike vertikaalne toruke, vedelikusamba kõrgused neis on vastavalt $h_1$ ja $h_2$ (toru teljest mõõtes). Leidke horisontaalsete torude diameetrite suhe. Hõõrdumist mitte arvestada.

Vihje. Vedeliku horisontaalsel voolamisel kehtib Bernoulli seadus kujul $\frac{\rho v^2}{2}+p=\mathrm{const}$, kus $p$ on hüdrostaatiline rõhk, $\rho$ vedeliku tihedus ning $v$ vedeliku kiirus. (8 p.)

problems.title: Solenoid
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Solenoid

There is a current $I$ in an air-core solenoid (a long cylindrical coil). Inside the solenoid an electron moves along a helix whose number of turns equals the number of turns of the solenoid. Find the axial component of the velocity of this electron. You may assume that the component of the electron's velocity perpendicular to the axis is small enough that no collisions with the wall of the solenoid occur. The mass of the electron is $m$ and its charge is $e$.

Hint: Inside the solenoid there is a homogeneous magnetic field with induction $B=\mu_0 nI$, where $n$ is the number of turns of wire of the solenoid per unit length, $I$ the current in it and $\mu_0$ the magnetic permeability of vacuum. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Solenoid

Õhksüdamikuga solenoidis (pikas silindrilises poolis) on vool $I$. Solenoidi sisemuses liigub elektron, mille trajektoor kujutab endast sellist kruvijoont, mille keerdude arv on võrdne solenoidi keerdude arvuga. Leidke selle elektroni kiiruse teljesihiline komponent. Võib eeldada, et elektroni kiiruse teljega risti olev komponent on piisavalt väike, et kokkupõrkeid solenoidi seinaga ei toimu. Elektroni mass on $m$ ja laeng $e$.

Vihje: Solenoidi sees on homogeenne magnetväli induktsiooniga $B=\mu_0 nI$, kus $n$ on solenoidi traadi keerdude arv pikkusühiku kohta, $I$ selles olev vool ja $\mu_0$ vaakumi magnetiline läbitavus. (10 p.)

problems.title: Photographer
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Photographer

A photographer photographed a stream of water falling from a high waterfall; the water drops sparkling in the sunlight were stretched into vertical streaks in the pictures. When the camera was in the normal position, all streaks had length $l_1=120$ pixels; when the camera was "upside down" (i.e. rotated by $180$ degrees about the optical axis), the length of the streaks was $l_2=200$ pixels. How long were the streaks when the camera was held in the "portrait position" (i.e. rotated by $90$ degrees about the optical axis)? Assume that the exposure time and the direction of the optical axis were the same in all cases. If the answer cannot be determined uniquely from the given data, give all possible answers.

Hint. The main components of a camera are the objective (lens) and the shutter; the former forms an image of the photographed objects in the plane of the digital sensor (or film). In the "rest position" this image does not fall on the sensor, however, because the shutter blocks the light that has come through the objective. When the release is pressed, the shutter opens for a short time interval (the exposure time): the image of the objects now really falls on the sensor, and each pixel of the sensor measures the whole light energy falling on it during that time. Usually the shutter consists of two "curtains" placed right in front of the sensor and covering it. At first the sensor is covered by the first curtain, whose upper edge moves from top to bottom with constant speed $v$ when the release is pressed, uncovering the sensor. The exposure is ended by the second curtain, whose lower edge also moves from top to bottom with the same speed $v$ as the first one. If the exposure time is very short, the sensor does not have time to open completely: both curtains move together from top to bottom and the sensor is open to the light coming from the objective only within the narrow horizontal strip between the curtains (this strip open to the light moves from top to bottom with speed $v$). (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Fotograaf

Fotograaf pildistas kõrgest joast langevat veevoolu; päikesevalguses sätendavad veepiisad venisid piltidel vertikaalseteks triipudeks. Kui fotoaparaat oli pildistamisel normaalasendis, siis olid kõik triibud pikkusega $l_1=120$ pikselit; kui fotoaparaat oli pildistamisel "jalad ülespidi" (st seda pöörati ümber optilise telje $180$ kraadi), siis oli triipude pikkuseks $l_2=200$ pikselit. Kui pikad olid triibud siis, kui fotoaparaati hoiti pildistamisel "portree asendis" (st seda pöörati ümber optilise telje $90$ kraadi)? Eeldada, et säriaeg ja optilise telje suund oli kõigil juhtudel üks ja sama. Kui toodud andmete põhjal pole vastus üheselt leitav, siis andke kõik võimalikud vastused.

Vihje. Fotoaparaadi põhikomponendid on objektiiv (lääts) ja katik, millest esimene tekitab digitaalsensori (või filmi) tasandile pildistatavate esemete kujutise. "Puhkeasendis" ei lange see kujutis siiski sensorile, sest katik varjab läbi objektiivi tulnud valguse ära. Päästikule vajutamisel avaneb katik lühikeseks ajavahemikuks (säriajaks): objektide kujutis langeb nüüd tõesti sensorile ning sensori iga piksel mõõdab ära kogu selle aja vältel langeva valgusenergia. Harilikult kujutab katik endast kahte "kardinat", mis paiknevad vahetult sensori ees ja katavad selle. Alguses varjab sensorit esimene kardin, mille ülemine serv liigub päästikule vajutamisel konstantse kiirusega $v$ ülevalt alla, avades sensori. Säriaja lõpetab teine kardin, mille alumine serv liigub samuti ülevalt alla, samasuguse kiirusega $v$ nagu esimenegi. Kui säriaeg on hästi lühike, siis ei jõua sensor täielikult avaneda: mõlemad kardinad liiguvad koos ülevalt alla ning sensor on avatud objektiivist tulevale valgusele vaid kardinate vahelise kitsa horisontaalse riba ulatuses (kusjuures see valgusele avatud riba liigub kiirusega $v$ ülevalt alla). (10 p.)

problems.title: Ring
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Ring

A ring in the form of a circle of radius $R$ is made of wire with non-uniform mass distribution. The centre of mass of this ring is at distance $R/2$ from the centre of the circle. The ring is hung on a horizontal shaft. What must the coefficient of friction $\mu$ between the ring and the shaft be so that the ring does not slip on the shaft when the shaft rotates slowly? (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Rõngas

Ebaühtlase massijaotusega traadist on tehtud rõngas, mis kujutab endast ringi raadiusega $R$. Selle rõnga massikese asub ringi keskpunktist kaugusel $R/2$. Rõngas asetatakse horisontaalsele võllile rippuma. Milline peab olema rõnga ja võlli vaheline hõõrdetegur $\mu$, et võlli aeglasel pöörlemisel rõngas võllil ei libiseks? (10 p.)

problems.title: Optical system
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Optical system

A thin biconvex lens with refractive index $n$ is made of glass; the radius of curvature of both its surfaces is $r$ (the thickness of the lens is $d\ll r$). One surface of the lens is coated with a reflecting metal layer. Find the focal length of the optical system formed by the convex lens and the concave mirror.

Hint. To find the focal length one may consider rays close to the optical axis, propagating at a small angle to it. In that case the small-angle formula $\sin\alpha\approx\tan\alpha\approx\alpha$ can be applied, where $\alpha$ is in radians. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Optiline süsteem

Klaasist murdumisnäitajaga $n$ on valmistatud õhuke kaksikkumer lääts, mille mõlema pinna kõverusraadius on $r$ (läätse paksus $d\ll r$). Läätse üks pind kaetakse peegeldava metallikihiga. Leidke kumerläätsest ja nõguspeeglist tekkinud optilise süsteemi fookuskaugus.

Vihje. Fookuskauguse leidmiseks võib vaadelda optilise peatelje lähedasi kiiri, mis levivad selle suhtes väikese nurga all. Sel juhul saab rakendada väikeste nurkade valemit $\sin\alpha\approx\tan\alpha\approx\alpha$, kus $\alpha$ on radiaanides. (10 p.)

problems.title: Nerve cell
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Nerve cell

The membrane of a nerve cell can be regarded as a thin film of capacitance $C$ pierced by ion channels that allow charges to move through the membrane. From the point of view of the electrical equilibrium of the nerve cell, the important ions are sodium and potassium. When a sodium ion (with charge $+e$) passes through an ion channel (entering the nerve cell), chemical forces do work $e\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$, i.e. one can say that an electromotive force $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$ acts on the sodium ions in the ion channel. For potassium ions the process of passing through the channel is exactly the same, but the effective electromotive force is $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{K}}$ ($\neq\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$). Besides the work of the chemical forces, friction forces also act on a charge moving in the ion channel; these can be described by means of an electrical resistance: for sodium ions the electrical resistance of the membrane is $R_{\mathrm{Na}}$ and for potassium ions $R_{\mathrm{K}}$. What charge does the membrane of the nerve cell acquire when electrical equilibrium is reached? (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Närvirakk

Närviraku membraani võib vaadelda kui õhukest kilet mahtuvusega $C$, mida läbivad ioonkanalid, mis võimaldavad laengutel liikuda läbi membraani. Närviraku elektrilise tasakaalu seisukohast on olulisteks ioonideks naatrium ja kaalium. Kui naatriumioon (laenguga $+e$) läbib ioonkanali (sisenedes närvirakku), siis sooritavad keemilised jõud töö $e\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$, st võib öelda, et naatriumioonidele mõjub ioonkanalis elektromotoorjõud $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$. Kaaliumioonide puhul on kanali läbimise protsess täpselt samasugune, kuid efektiivne elektromotoorjõud on sel puhul $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{K}}$ ($\neq\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{Na}}$). Peale keemiliste jõudude töö toimivad laengu liikumisel ioonkanalis ka hõõrdejõud, mida saab kirjeldada elektrilise takistuse abil: naatriumioonide jaoks on membraani elektriline takistus $R_{\mathrm{Na}}$ ja kaaliumioonide jaoks $R_{\mathrm{K}}$. Millise laengu omandab närviraku membraan elektrilise tasakaalu saabudes? (10 p.)

problems.title: Screw jack
problems.problem:

The figure shows a screw jack of simple construction whose thread pitch is $3\ \mathrm{mm}$. A car presses on the jack with force $F=5\ \mathrm{kN}$. Consider the moment when $\alpha=40^\circ$. For the dimensions of the jack see the figure.

a) With what force must one act on the handle of the crank to lift the car, if friction between all sliding surfaces is neglected? (9 points)

b) If the friction were in reality also negligibly small, the jack would not stay in the screwed-up position: as soon as the handle is released, it would start to rotate under the weight of the car and the car would sink down again. Answer the previous question assuming that the coefficient of friction is just so large (i.e. not larger than barely necessary) that the jack stays in the screwed-up position. (3 points)

Joonisel on kujutatud lihtsa konstruktsiooniga tungraud, mille keerme samm on $3\ \mathrm{mm}$. Tungrauale surub auto jõuga $F=5\ \mathrm{kN}$. Vaatleme hetke, millal $\alpha=40^\circ$. Tungraua mõõtmeid vaadake jooniselt.

problems.title: Friction welding
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Friction welding

A relatively new welding technology is friction welding. It consists in setting one of the parts to be joined into rotation and pressing it against the other. When the heat produced has heated the parts almost to the melting temperature, the rotating part is stopped and a bond forms under high pressure. Consider the situation where two copper pipe pieces are to be welded together. Find with what force the pipes must be pressed together during rotation so that a sufficiently large amount of heat is produced during $\Delta t=6\ \mathrm{s}$. The rotation speed of the pipe is $f=1200$ revolutions per minute. In a simplified way one may assume that a piece of length $l=0.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ at the end of each pipe is heated uniformly. The diameter of the pipes is $D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$, the wall thickness is $d=5\ \mathrm{mm}$. Initially the pipes are at room temperature $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Joining takes place at temperature $T_1=810\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The coefficient of friction of copper with itself is $\mu=0.96$, its density is $\rho=8.9\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$ and its specific heat is $c=390\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot{}^\circ C)}$. Do not take heat losses to the surroundings into account. (6 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Hõõrdkeevitus

Suhteliselt uus keevitustehnoloogia on hõõrdkeevitus. See seisneb selles, et üks liidetavatest detailidest pannakse pöörlema ning surutakse vastu teist. Kui tekkinud soojus on detailid peaaegu sulamistemperatuurini kuumutanud, jäetakse pöörlev detail seisma ning suure rõhu all moodustub side. Vaatame olukorda, kus kaks vasest torujuppi tahetakse kokku keevitada. Leidke, kui suure jõuga peab pöörlemise ajal torusid kokku suruma, et tekiks piisavalt suur soojushulk $\Delta t=6\ \mathrm{s}$ jooksul. Toru pöörlemiskiirus on $f=1200$ pööret minutis. Lihtsustatult võib eeldada, et mõlema toru otsast kuumeneb ühtlaselt $l=0{,}5\ \mathrm{cm}$ pikkune jupp. Torude diameeter on $D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$, seina paksus $d=5\ \mathrm{mm}$. Torud on alguses toatemperatuuril $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Liitumine toimub temperatuuril $T_1=810\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Vase hõõrdetegur iseendaga on $\mu=0{,}96$, tihedus $\rho=8{,}9\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$ ning erisoojus $c=390\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot{}^\circ C)}$. Soojuskadudega ümbritsevasse keskkonda mitte arvestada. (6 p.)

Problem 6: Pond

Consider the ripples that form around a stone thrown into a pond. When the stone falls into the water, a large number of disturbances of different wavelengths arise, each of which propagates with its own speed. Their superposition forms a wave crest whose motion we can observe. In the figure (larger on the additional sheet) the position of this wave crest is marked after each fixed time interval; the scale is given by a line segment of length $L$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2013-6-fig1.png

The speed $v$ of the wave crest depends on the wavelengths $\lambda$ of the components that form it at the moment and on the depth $h$ of the water. When the time $t$ elapsed since the stone fell into the water is small, the wave crest consists of wavelengths $\lambda\ll h$, and the speed of the crest depends on time according to $v\approx\frac{gt}{\pi}$. Farther away, where the disturbances forming the crest have wavelength $\lambda\gg h$, it moves with speed $v\approx\sqrt{hg}$. Estimate the depth $h$, assuming that it was the same throughout the pond. Give the answer as the ratio $h/L$. (10 points)

Nende liitumisel moodustub lainehari, mille liikumist saame vaadelda. Joonisele (suuremalt lisalehele) on iga kindla ajavahemiku järel kantud selle laineharja asukoht, mõõtkavaks sirglõik pikkusega $L$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2013-6-fig1.png

Kui kivi vettekukkumisest möödunud aeg $t$ on väike, siis koosneb lainehari lainepikkustest $\lambda\ll h$ ning laineharja kiirus sõltub ajast seose $v\approx\frac{gt}{\pi}$ järgi. Kaugemal, kus laineharja moodustavad häiritused lainepikkusega $\lambda\gg h$, liigub see kiirusega $v\approx\sqrt{hg}$. Hinnake sügavust $h$ eeldusel, et see oli terve tiigi ulatuses sama. Terav kujutis tekib objektiivi kahe erineva asendi korral. Vastavate joonsuurenduste suhteks määrati $25$. Kummas asendis ja mitu korda on sensori pinnaühikule langev kiirgusvõimsus suurem? problems.title: Shop
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Shop

Larger buildings often have vestibules. Why? Consider a shop to which such a narrow vestibule was added that this extension does not affect the heat losses through the walls of the shop. When the door of the shop is opened, a certain amount of air is exchanged through the open door. Let us assume that the air is well mixed everywhere, i.e. through the open door air at the outdoor temperature goes from outside into the vestibule; we make analogous assumptions for all doors. We also assume that the amount of air exchanged by one opening of a door does not depend on the temperature difference, and that the heat losses due to the thermal conductivity of the doors and the walls of the vestibule are negligible compared with those due to the exchange of air.

Consider the situation before the vestibule was built. On a cool April day the outdoor temperature during the opening hours of the shop was a steady $T_1=4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. At night, when the shop is closed, the outdoor temperature was a steady $T_2=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The operation of the electric radiators of the shop is controlled by a thermostat that keeps the indoor temperature constant at $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. At night the average power of the radiators was $P_2=5.0\ \mathrm{kW}$ and during the day $P_1=4.6\ \mathrm{kW}$. During the day two effects act: (a) people open the door from time to time; (b) the body heat of people and the lamps of the shop contribute some additional heating power.

After the vestibule was built, it turned out that at the same outdoor temperature and the same number of visitors the average daytime power of the radiators decreased to $P_3=3.8\ \mathrm{kW}$. What power is produced by the people and the lamps in the shop, assuming that the power of heat exchange is proportional to the temperature difference? (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Kauplus

Suurematel hoonetel on sageli eeskojad. Miks? Vaadelgem kauplust, millele ehitati nii kitsas eeskoda, et läbi kaupluse seinte toimuvaid soojuskadusid see juurdeehitis ei mõjuta. Kaupluse ukse avamisel vahetub läbi avatud ukse teatud kogus õhku. Lugegem õhk kõikjal hästi segunenuks, st läbi lahtise ukse läheb õuest eeskotta õuetemperatuuril õhk; kõigi uste jaoks teeme analoogilised eeldused. Samuti eeldame, et ühe ukseavamisega vahetuva õhu hulk ei sõltu temperatuuride vahest ning et uste ja eeskoja seinte soojusjuhtivusest tingitud soojuskaod on tühised võrreldes õhu vahetumisest tingitutega.

Vaatleme olukorda enne eeskoja ehitamist. Jahedal aprillipäeval oli kaupluse lahtioleku aegne välistemperatuur stabiilselt $T_1=4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Öösel, kui kauplus on kinni, oli välistemperatuur stabiilselt $T_2=0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kaupluse elektriradiaatorite tööd juhib termostaat, mis hoiab sisetemperatuuri püsivalt $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ juures. Öösel oli radiaatorite keskmine võimsus $P_2=5{,}0\ \mathrm{kW}$ ning päeval $P_1=4{,}6\ \mathrm{kW}$. Päeval toimib kaks efekti: (a) inimesed avavad aeg-ajalt ust; (b) inimeste kehasoojus ning kaupluse valgustid panustavad kütmisse teatava lisavõimsusega.

Pärast eesruumi ehitamist selgus, et sama välistemperatuuri ning külastajate arvu juures vähenes radiaatorite päevane keskmine võimsus $P_3=3{,}8\ \mathrm{kW}$-ni. Millist võimsust toodavad kaupluses olevad inimesed ja valgustid, kui eeldada, et soojusvahetuse võimsus on võrdeline temperatuuride vahega? (10 p.)

problems.title: Footballers
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Footballers

Two footballers tried a trick shot in which two balls collide in the air. The footballers stood at a distance $d=20\ \mathrm{m}$ from each other and, with kicks made at the same moment, each gave his ball an initial speed $v=15\ \mathrm{m/s}$. In what region could the balls collide in flight? As the answer, make a drawing in top view showing the positions of the footballers and the region of all possible collision points. Also give the dimensions of this region. The height of the possible collision points above the ground need not be calculated separately or marked in the drawing. The acceleration of free fall is $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Jalgpallurid

Kaks jalgpallurit proovisid trikilööki, kus kaks palli õhus kokku põrkavad. Jalgpallurid seisid teineteisest $d=20\ \mathrm{m}$ kaugusel ja andsid samal ajahetkel sooritatud löögiga kumbki oma pallile algkiiruse $v=15\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Mis piirkonnas võisid pallid lennul kokku põrgata? Vastuseks tehke pealtvaates joonis, kuhu on kantud jalgpallurite asukohad ja kõikvõimalike kokkupõrkepunktide piirkond. Esitage ka selle piirkonna mõõdud. Võimalike kokkupõrkepunktide kõrgust maapinnast pole vaja eraldi välja arvutada ega joonisele kanda. Raskuskiirendus on $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Capacitor
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Capacitor

A capacitor with square plates of area $S$ and a distance between the plates $d\ll\sqrt S$ is charged to voltage $U_0$ and then disconnected from the battery. A square conducting plate, also of area $S$ and of thickness $d/2$, is inserted into the capacitor until the plate is completely inside the capacitor. During the process the plate does not touch the plates of the capacitor and is parallel to them. How much work was done in inserting the plate? Explain whether the plate was pulled in by itself or whether external forces had to push it in. Edge effects need not be taken into account. The permittivity of vacuum is $\varepsilon_0$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Kondensaator

Ruudukujuliste plaatidega kondensaator plaadi pindalaga $S$ ning plaatidevahelise kaugusega $d\ll\sqrt S$ on laetud pingeni $U_0$ ning seejärel patareist lahti ühendatud. Kondensaatori sisse viiakse ruudukujuline juhtiv plaat, samuti pindalaga $S$ ning paksusega $d/2$, kuni plaat on täielikult kondensaatori sees. Protsessi jooksul plaat ei puutu kokku kondensaatori plaatidega ning on nendega paralleelne. Kui palju tööd tehti plaadi sisseviimisel? Selgitage, kas plaat tõmbus ise sisse või pidid välisjõud selle sisse lükkama. Servaefekte pole vaja arvesse võtta. Vaakumi dielektriline läbitavus on $\varepsilon_0$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Square grid
problems.problem:

A $2\times 2$ square grid has been made of wire (see the figure); the resistance of each side of a small square is $r=1\ \Omega$. Find the resistance between points A and B. (8 points)

Ülesanne 1: Ruudustik

Traadist on valmistatud $2\times 2$ ruudustik (vt joonist), iga väikese ruudu külje takistus on $r=1\ \Omega$. Leidke punktide A ja B vaheline takistus. (8 p.)

problems.title: Violin
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Violin

When a violin string of length $L$ is pressed down at a distance $\frac37 L$ from one end of the string and the shorter part is drawn with a bow, a sound with some fundamental frequency is heard. When the string is only touched at the same distance $\frac37 L$ (not pressed down), the sound heard is different. What is the ratio of these two fundamental frequencies? (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Viiul

Viiuli keelt pikkusega $L$ kaugusel $\frac37 L$ keele ühest otsast alla vajutades ning lühemal osal poognaga tõmmates kõlab mingi põhisagedusega heli. Samal kaugusel $\frac37 L$ keelt ainult puudutades (alla vajutamata), on kõlav heli erinev. Milline on nende kahe põhisageduse suhe? (8 p.)

problems.title: Expansion tank
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Expansion tank

The heating system of a house contains a large storage tank in which circulating warm water is kept, and an expansion tank to compensate for the thermal expansion of the water. The expansion tank is a vessel of fixed volume, part of which is occupied by air, while the rest is filled with water from the heating system, which can flow freely into the system and back. At a moment when all the water was at room temperature $t_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, the expansion tank was filled with compressed air so that the volume of the air in the tank was $V_1=0.080\ \mathrm{m^3}$ and the pressure was $p_1=1.5\,p_0$, where $p_0=0.10\ \mathrm{MPa}$ is the atmospheric pressure. The volume of all the water in the system at room temperature is $V_0=1.0\ \mathrm{m^3}$.

The piping also has an emergency valve to prevent the pipes from bursting. The valve opens when the pressure in the piping exceeds atmospheric pressure by $\Delta p=1.2\,p_0$. To what temperature can the water in the system be heated without the emergency valve opening? Disregard the thermal expansion of the metal. The dependence of the density of water on temperature is given in the graph. Assume that the shape of the graph does not depend on pressure (the pressure changes considered are too small for that). Also assume that the temperature of the air in the expansion tank stays at room temperature $t_0$. (8 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2014-3-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Paisupaak

Maja küttesüsteem sisaldab suurt akumulatsioonipaaki, kus hoitakse ringlevat sooja vett, ning paisupaaki, et kompenseerida vee soojuspaisumist. Paisupaak on fikseeritud ruumalaga anum, millest osa võtab enda alla õhk ning ülejäänu täidab küttesüsteemist pärinev vesi, mis saab vabalt süsteemi ja tagasi voolata. Hetkel, mil kogu vesi oli toatemperatuuril $t_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, täideti paisupaak suruõhuga nii, et õhu ruumala paagis oli $V_1=0{,}080\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ning rõhk $p_1=1{,}5\,p_0$, kus $p_0=0{,}10\ \mathrm{MPa}$ on atmosfäärirõhk. Kogu süsteemis oleva vee ruumala toatemperatuuril on $V_0=1{,}0\ \mathrm{m^3}$.

Torustikus on ka avariiventiil, et vältida torude lõhkemist. Ventiil avaneb, kui rõhk torustikus ületab atmosfäärirõhku $\Delta p=1{,}2\,p_0$ võrra. Millise temperatuurini saab vett süsteemis soojendada, ilma et avariiventiil avaneks? Metalli soojuspaisumisega mitte arvestada. Vee tiheduse sõltuvus temperatuurist on toodud graafikul. Eeldage, et graafiku kuju ei sõltu rõhust (vaadeldavad rõhumuutused on selleks liiga väiksed). Samuti eeldage, et õhu temperatuur paisupaagis püsib toatemperatuuril $t_0$. (8 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2014-3-fig1.png

problems.title: Periscope glasses
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Periscope glasses

If one reads a book for too long at a stretch, the neck may become tired from looking downwards for a long time. To avoid this, special glasses have been invented with which one can look down without tilting the head. The main element of the glasses is the prism shown in the figure, whose upper face is covered with a light-reflecting material. The apex angle $\varphi$ of the prism is chosen so that if a light ray entering the prism is perpendicular to the surface, then the exiting ray is perpendicular as well. The prism is made of a material with refractive index $n=1.5$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2014-4-fig1.png

1. On the segment $AD$ there are points $B$ and $C$ that divide it into three regions: $AB$, $BC$ and $CD$. Depending on which region the ray hits, there are three fundamentally different possibilities for the path of the ray in the prism. Draw the paths of the rays for all cases.

2. Find the value of the angle $\varphi$.

3. Let the length of side $AD$ be $l$. How far from the vertex $A$ are the points $B$ and $C$?

4. Why is it necessary to use a relatively complicated system with a prism in the glasses at all, instead of using a single plane mirror to deflect the rays?

(10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Periskoopprillid

Kui liiga kaua järjest raamatut lugeda, siis võib kael pikast allapoole vaatamisest ära väsida. Selle vältimiseks on välja mõeldud erilised prillid, mille abil saab pead kallutamata alla vaadata. Prillide põhiliseks elemendiks on joonisel kujutatud prisma, mille pealmine tahk on kaetud valgust peegeldava materjaliga. Prisma tipunurk $\varphi$ on valitud selliselt, et kui prismasse sisenev valguskiir on pinnaga risti, siis on seda ka väljuv kiir. Prisma on tehtud materjalist murdumisnäitajaga $n=1{,}5$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2014-4-fig1.png

1. Lõigul $AD$ on punktid $B$ ja $C$, mis jagavad selle kolmeks piirkonnaks: $AB$, $BC$ ning $CD$. Sõltuvalt sellest, millisele piirkonnale kiir langeb, on kiire käiguks prismas kolm põhimõtteliselt erinevat võimalust. Tehke joonis kiirte käigust kõigi juhtude jaoks.

2. Leidke nurga $\varphi$ väärtus.

3. Olgu külje $AD$ pikkus $l$. Kui kaugel asuvad punktid $B$ ja $C$ tipust $A$?

4. Miks on prillides üldse vaja kasutada suhteliselt keerulist prismaga süsteemi selle asemel, et kiirte kallutamiseks kasutada ühte tasapeeglit?

(10 p.)

Kaks kammi on asetatud üksteise taha nii, nagu näidatud joonisel. Halli kammi liigutatakse kiirusega $v=1\ \mathrm{cm/s}$ ning musta kammi hoitakse paigal. Millise kiirusega ja millises suunas liiguvad tumedad laigud? (10 p.)

problems.title: Compound pulley
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Compound pulley

To pull out a mountaineer who has fallen into a crevasse, a compound pulley system (polyspast) has been put together from available means (three blocks and pieces of rope). In the simplified figure the main rope is drawn with a thick line; the fallen person is at one end of it and the other end is being hauled. The blocks, drawn with thin lines, are fastened to the main rope by a cord with a non-slipping knot (filled circle in the figure). Find the force transmission ratio (mechanical advantage) of the pulley system both ignoring friction and assuming that friction reduces the force transmission by $35\%$ at each block. Assume that all forces are vertical. (10 points)

Leidke polüspasti ülekandetegur nii hõõrdumist arvestamata kui ka eeldusel, et hõõrdumine vähendab jõuülekannet igal plokil $35\%$. Eeldage, et kõik jõud on vertikaalsed. (10 p.)

problems.title: Sports car

Problem 7: Sports car

Find the maximum acceleration of a front-wheel-drive car. The mass of the car is $m$, the distance between the front and rear axles is $b$, the height of the centre of mass is $h$ and the horizontal distance of the centre of mass from the rear axle is $s$. The coefficient of friction between the wheels and the ground is $\mu$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Sportauto

Leidke esirattaveolise sõiduauto maksimaalne kiirendus. Auto mass on $m$, esi- ja tagarataste telgede vahe $b$, masskeskme kõrgus $h$ ning masskeskme horisontaalne kaugus tagateljest $s$. Hõõrdetegur rataste ja maa vahel on $\mu$. (10 p.)

problems.title: Cylindrical vessels

A cylindrical vessel with inner radius $R=30\ \mathrm{mm}$ is filled with water. Ülesanne 8: Silindrilised anumad

Silindriline anum siseraadiusega $R=30\ \mathrm{mm}$ on täidetud veega. Teine tühi silindriline anum raadiusega $r=25\ \mathrm{mm}$, mille mass on tühiselt väike, on surutud koaksiaalselt suurema silindri sisse nii, et selle vettesukeldunud osa pikkus $L=300\ \mathrm{mm}$ (vt joonist). Leidke sisemise silindri kiirendus vahetult pärast seda, kui see vabaks lastakse. Vee pindpinevuse ning viskoossusega arvestada pole tarvis. (12 p.)

problems.title: Wire rings
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Wire rings

Two identical wire rings of radius $R$ are in immediate proximity, the planes of the rings are parallel and the rings touch each other at points $A$ and $B$. The central angle corresponding to the arc $AB$ is $\alpha$ at the moment considered. The lower ring is at rest, the upper one rotates with angular velocity $\omega$ about an axis passing through point $A$ and perpendicular to the planes of the rings. Find the velocity of the contact point $B$ of the rings at the given moment. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Traatrõngad

Kaks ühesugust traatrõngast raadiusega $R$ on üksteise vahetus läheduses, rõngaste tasandid on paralleelsed ning rõngad puudutavad üksteist punktides $A$ ja $B$. Kaarele $AB$ vastav kesknurk on vaadeldaval ajahetkel $\alpha$. Alumine rõngas on paigal, ülemine pöörleb nurkkiirusega $\omega$ ümber punkti $A$ läbiva ning rõngaste tasanditega risti oleva telje. problems.title: Glass cylinder
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Glass cylinder

A point is marked with a marker on the outer surface of a glass cylinder. When the cylinder is viewed from a large distance (much greater than the radius of the cylinder) so that the point appears, seen through the cylinder, to lie on its axis of symmetry, then two further images of the point can be seen. One image is seen on one side of the axis of symmetry and the other on the other side. When the cylinder is rotated about its axis of symmetry, at a certain moment the two images of the point merge and disappear. The third image remains. When the cylinder is rotated further, at the moment when its angle of rotation relative to the initial position is $15^\circ$, the third image also disappears, so that the point made with the marker is no longer visible at all. What is the refractive index of the glass? (14 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Klaassilinder

Klaassilindri välispinnal märgitakse markeriga punkt. Kui seda silindrit vaadata suurelt kauguselt (hulga suuremalt kui silindri raadius) nii, et punkt paistab läbi silindri selle sümmeetriateljel olevat, siis on lisaks näha veel kahte punkti kujutist. Üks kujutis on näha ühel ja teine teisel pool sümmeetriatelge. Kui silindrit keerata ümber oma sümmeetriatelje, siis teatud hetkel sulavad kaks punkti kujutist kokku ning kaovad ära. Kolmas kujutis jääb alles. Kui silindrit edasi keerata, siis hetkel, kui selle pöördenurk algasendi suhtes on $15^\circ$, kaob ka kolmas kujutis, nõnda et markeriga tehtud punkti polegi enam näha. Kui suur on klaasi murdumisnäitaja? (14 p.)

problems.title: Balloon

The mass of the balloon envelope is included in the mass of the load. Õhupalli kesta mass on arvestatud koormise massi sisse. Õhu tihedus on $\rho=1{,}2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, õhu rõhk $p=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$, õhu temperatuur $T=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. problems.title: Floating cube

A thin-walled sealed cube floats on the surface of a liquid. The density of the liquid is $\rho$, the mass of the cube together with the gas inside it is $m$, and its edge length is $a$. problems.title: Shock wave

Problem 6: Shock wave

An electrostatic shock wave propagating with speed $w$ along the $x$-axis can be described by the electric potential: $U=0$ for $x<wt$ and $U=U_0$ for $x>wt$. What speed $v$ does a particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$, initially at rest, acquire under the action of the shock wave? Give the answer as a function of the height $U_0$ of the potential barrier. problems.title: Spring
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Spring

Inside a box, a load is hung from a spring. Both the box and the load have mass $m$. The mass of the spring is negligibly small and its spring constant is $k$. The box is let fall freely from a height $h$ so that the load is in equilibrium during the fall. On collision with a soft surface the box stops instantly. The box is tall enough that the load does not hit the box. The spring is never compressed completely.

a) What is the smallest height $h_m$ from which the box, when dropped, bounces back up?

b) The box was dropped from the initial height $h\approx h_m$ found in part a). For how long a time $t$ does the box stay on the ground before rising?

Note: Observe that a load in free fall is weightless and therefore the spring is unstretched during the fall. When reaching the ground the load is no longer in its equilibrium position and therefore starts to oscillate about the new equilibrium position with angular frequency $\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. (12 points)

Kastil lastakse kõrguselt $h$ vabalt maha kukkuda nii, et langemise ajal on koormis tasakaaluolekus. Kokkupõrkel pehme pinnaga jääb kast hetkeliselt paigale. Kast on piisavalt kõrge selleks, et koormis vastu kasti ei põrkaks. Vedrut ei suruta ühelgi hetkel täielikult kokku.

a) Milline on vähim kõrgus $h_m$, millelt kukkudes hüppab kast tagasi üles?

b) Kastil lasti kukkuda punktis a) leitud algkõrguselt $h\approx h_m$. Kui pika ajavahemiku $t$ veedab kast maapinnal enne üles kerkimist?

Märkus: Pange tähele, et vabalangemises olev koormis on kaaluta olekus ning seetõttu on vedru langemise ajal välja venitamata. Maapinnale jõudes pole koormis enam tasakaaluasendis ning hakkab seetõttu uue tasakaaluasendi ümber võnkuma nurksagedusega $\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Heat exchanger
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Heat exchanger

In a counter-flow heat exchanger, incoming crude oil at temperature $T_n=90\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is cooled to temperature $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The cooling water moves through the heat exchanger in the direction opposite to the oil and enters the heat exchanger at temperature $T_v=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The water flows at the rate $v_v=6\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$ and the oil flows at the rate $v_n=15\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$. Find the temperature at which the water leaves the heat exchanger. The specific heat of water is $c_v=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot ^\circ C)}$ and the specific heat of oil is $c_n=1800\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot ^\circ C)}$. The density of water is $\rho_v=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ and the density of oil is $\rho_n=850\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. (6 points)

Vesi liigub kiirusega $v_v=6\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$ ja nafta liigub kiirusega $v_n=15\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$. Leidke, millise temperatuuriga väljub soojusvahetist vesi? Vee erisoojus $c_v=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot ^\circ C)}$ ja nafta erisoojus $c_n=1800\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot ^\circ C)}$. problems.title: Radon
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Radon

Graptolite argillite (also known as dictyonema shale) is a sedimentary clay rock outcropping in Northern Estonia, which contains many rare elements, including uranium. One tonne of the rock contains $300\ \mathrm{g}$ of the isotope uranium-238. The half-life of the most common isotope of uranium, with atomic mass 238, is $\tau_U=4.5$ billion years, and an intermediate stage of its decay chain is the radioactive element radon, with atomic mass 222 and half-life $\tau_{Rn}=3.8$ days. Radon is a gas that is considered to cause lung cancer, because on inhalation its radioactive decay products enter the body. Therefore the relevant regulations stipulate that the radon activity in the indoor air of buildings must be less than $200\ \mathrm{Bq/m^3}$, where the unit Bq, named after Henri Becquerel, denotes one nuclear decay per second.

A hiker unsuspectingly brought home from a hike a piece of graptolite argillite of mass $m$ and placed it in the bedroom on top of a wardrobe. Assume, in a simplified way, that there is no air exchange in the bedroom of volume $V=25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ and that all the gaseous radon formed escapes from the rock. Find the largest safe mass $m$ of the piece of rock, such that the radon activity caused by it still stays within the permitted norms when the rock is kept in the room for a long time. (10 points)

Note: the atomic mass unit is $u=1.7\cdot 10^{-27}\ \mathrm{kg}$.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Radoon

Graptoliitargilliit (tuntud ka diktüoneemakilda nime all) on Põhja-Eestis paljanduv setteline savikivim, mis sisaldab hulgaliselt haruldasi elemente, muuhulgas uraani. Üks tonn kivimit sisaldab $300\ \mathrm{g}$ uraan-238 isotoopi. Uraani levinuima isotoobi, aatommassiga 238, poolestusaeg $\tau_U=4{,}5$ miljardit aastat ning selle lagunemisahela vaheetapiks on radioaktiivne element radoon, aatommassiga 222 ning poolestusajaga $\tau_{Rn}=3{,}8$ päeva. Radoon on gaas, mida peetakse kopsuvähi tekitajaks, sest sissehingamisel satuvad organismi selle radioaktiivsed laguproduktid. Seetõttu sätestavad vastavad normatiivid, et hoonete ruumiõhus peab radooni aktiivsus olema väiksem kui $200\ \mathrm{Bq/m^3}$, kus Henri Becquereli järgi nimetatud ühik Bq tähistab üht tuuma lagunemist sekundis.

Matkaja tõi pahaaimamatult matkalt koju kaasa ühe graptoliitargilliidi tükikese massiga $m$ ning paigutas selle magamistuppa kapi peale. Arvestage lihtsustatult, et magamistoas ruumalaga $V=25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ õhuvahetust ei toimu ning et kogu tekkiv gaasiline radoon väljub kivimist. Leidke kivimitükikese suurim ohutu mass $m$, nii et sellest tingitud radooni aktiivsus jääks veel lubatud normidesse, kui kivimit hoida pikka aega toas. (10 p.)

Märkus: aatommassiühik $u=1{,}7\cdot 10^{-27}\ \mathrm{kg}$.

problems.title: Motorboat

Problem 9: Motorboat

A motorboat travelled to an island located at distance $l=4\ \mathrm{km}$ straight to the south. First the course was set to the first sea mark, then the boat turned in another direction and finally set a course straight for the island; thus the trajectory consisted of three straight segments. The speed and direction of the wind were measured from the boat: the first segment was travelled for $t_1=3\ \mathrm{min}$ and the wind speed was measured as $v_1=15\ \mathrm{m/s}$ with the perceived direction straight from the east; the second segment was travelled for $t_2=1.5\ \mathrm{min}$ and the wind speed was measured as $v_2=10\ \mathrm{m/s}$ with the perceived direction straight from the southeast (between south and east); the third segment was travelled for $t_3=1.5\ \mathrm{min}$ and the wind speed was measured as $v_3=5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ with the perceived direction straight from the southwest (between south and west). What was the true wind speed?

Note: the speed of the boat could be different on different segments, but it was kept constant during each segment; the time spent on turning and accelerating was negligible; the true direction and speed of the wind did not change. (14 points)
problems.problem_orig:

Kaatrilt mõõdeti tuule kiirust ja suunda: esimest lõiku sõideti $t_1=3\ \mathrm{min}$ ja tuule kiiruseks mõõdeti $v_1=15\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ning tajutav suund oli otse idast, teist lõiku sõideti $t_2=1{,}5\ \mathrm{min}$ ja tuule kiiruseks mõõdeti $v_2=10\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ning tajutav suund oli otse kagust (lõuna-ida vahelt), kolmandat lõiku sõideti $t_3=1{,}5\ \mathrm{min}$ ja tuule kiiruseks mõõdeti $v_3=5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ning tajutav suund oli otse edelast (lõuna-lääne vahelt). Märkus: eri lõikudel võis paadi kiirus olla erinev, kuid iga lõigu kestel hoiti konstantne; pööramiseks ja kiirendamiseks kulunud aeg oli tühine; tuule tegelik suund ja kiirus ei muutunud. (14 p.)

problems.problem:
Problem 3: Laser

A laser beam of uniform diameter $d=1\ \mathrm{mm}$ is incident perpendicularly on the first surface of a wedge-shaped glass plate (the angle between the surfaces is $\varphi=2^\circ$). The laser beam consists of monochromatic components with wavelengths $\lambda_1=355\ \mathrm{nm}$ and $\lambda_2=532\ \mathrm{nm}$. The refractive indices of the glass at these wavelengths are $n_1=1.48$ and $n_2=1.46$, respectively. Find the distance $l$ from the glass plate at which the light beams of different wavelengths are completely separated from each other. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Laser

Laserkiir ühtlase diameetriga $d=1\ \mathrm{mm}$ langeb risti kiilukujulise klaasplaadi esimesele pinnale (pindade vaheline nurk $\varphi=2^\circ$). Laserkiire koosseisus on monokromaatsed komponendid lainepikkustega $\lambda_1=355\ \mathrm{nm}$ ja $\lambda_2=532\ \mathrm{nm}$. Klaasi murdumisnäitajad nendel lainepikkustel on vastavalt $n_1=1{,}48$ ja $n_2=1{,}46$. Leidke kaugus $l$ klaasplaadist, kus erineva lainepikkusega valguskiired on teineteisest täielikult eraldunud. (8 p.)

problems.title: Helium-filled basketball throw
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Basketball

If a basketball is filled with helium instead of air, the range of flight changes. The diameter of the basketball is $D=23\ \mathrm{cm}$, the mass of the shell is $m=0.63\ \mathrm{kg}$, the density of air is $\rho_0=1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, and the density of helium is $\rho_{He}=0.17\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. How many times farther can a helium-filled basketball be thrown compared with an air-filled basketball, if their initial velocities are equal? Air resistance is to be neglected in the calculations. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Korvpall

Kui täita korvpall õhu asemel heeliumiga, siis lennukaugus muutub. Korvpalli läbimõõt $D=23\ \mathrm{cm}$, kesta mass $m=0{,}63\ \mathrm{kg}$, õhu tihedus $\rho_0=1{,}2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, heeliumi tihedus $\rho_{He}=0{,}17\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Mitu korda kaugemale on võimalik visata heeliumiga täidetud korvpalli võrreldes õhuga täidetud korvpalliga, kui nende algkiirused on võrdsed? Arvutustes õhutakistusega mitte arvestada. (8 p.)

problems.title: Decelerating train on a circular arc
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Passenger train

A passenger train travels along a circular-arc section of railway, decelerating uniformly. The length of the section is $s$ and the train takes time $t$ to pass it. After passing this section, the direction of motion of the train has changed by an angle $\varphi$, and at the beginning of the section the speed of the train was $\alpha$ times greater than at the end of the section. Find the relation between the mass $m$ of a passenger sitting in the train and his weight $P$ when the train is exactly at the midpoint of this section. Find the passenger's mass if $P=840\ \mathrm{N}$, $s=1.5\ \mathrm{km}$, $t=60\ \mathrm{s}$, $\alpha=1.5$, $\varphi=60^\circ$ and $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Reisirong

Reisirong sõidab mööda raudtee ringjoone kaare kujulist lõiku ühtlaselt aeglustudes. Lõigu pikkus on $s$ ja rongil kulub selle läbimiseks aeg $t$. Pärast selle lõigu läbimist on rongi liikumise suund muutunud nurga $\varphi$ võrra ja lõigu alguses oli rongi kiirus $\alpha$ korda suurem, kui see on lõigu lõpus. Leidke seos rongis istuva reisija massi $m$ ja tema kaalu $P$ vahel, kui reisirong on parajasti selle lõigu keskpunktis. Leidke reisija mass, kui $P=840\ \mathrm{N}$, $s=1{,}5\ \mathrm{km}$, $t=60\ \mathrm{s}$, $\alpha=1{,}5$, $\varphi=60^\circ$ ja $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (8 p.)

problems.title: Inflating a balloon with a pump
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Balloon

Juku wants to inflate a balloon. He has a large pump with a valve at its end, which is initially closed. He attaches a balloon to the pump and then presses on the pump until the pressure in the pump rises to $p$. Because of the compression, the temperature of the air in the pump rises to $T$. Juku opens the valve and the balloon fills slowly, while the handle of the pump gradually sinks lower. Throughout the whole process Juku presses on the pump with exactly the same force as at the beginning. What is the temperature of the air in the balloon when it is fully inflated? Heat losses through the pump and the walls of the balloon are to be neglected, and so is the work done in stretching the rubber of the balloon. The external air pressure and temperature are $p_0$ and $T_0$. The heat capacity of air at constant volume is $c_V$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Õhupall

Juku tahab õhupalli täis pumbata. Tal on suur pump, mille otsas olev ventiil on alguses suletud. Ta paneb pumba otsa õhupalli, seejärel vajutab pumbale peale, kuni rõhk pumbas tõuseb $p$-ni. Kokku surumise tõttu tõuseb pumbas oleva õhu temperatuur $T$-ni. Juku keerab ventiili lahti ja õhupall täitub aeglaselt, samal ajal vajub pumba käepide järjest allapoole. Juku vajutab kogu protsessi vältel pumbale täpselt sama suure jõuga kui alguses. Mis on õhu temperatuur õhupallis, kui see on täis pumbatud? Soojuskadudega läbi pumba ja õhupalli seinte mitte arvestada, samuti õhupalli kummi venitamisel tehtud tööga mitte arvestada. Väline õhurõhk ja temperatuur on $p_0$ ja $T_0$. Õhu soojumahtuvus konstantsel ruumalal on $c_V$. (10 p.)

problems.title: Compact camera with a concave lens
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Camera

Juku photographs the aurora with a self-built camera, which consists of a square light-sensitive element with side length $2h=2.0\ \mathrm{cm}$ and a convex lens with focal length $f=14\ \mathrm{cm}$. Juku does not like the camera being so large and wants the camera to be at most $L_m=7.0\ \mathrm{cm}$ long. For this purpose, he replaces the old convex lens with a new convex lens of focal length $f_2=3.0\ \mathrm{cm}$ placed at distance $L_m$ from the light-sensitive element. What focal length should one concave lens have, and how far from the convex lens should Juku add it to the system, so that the original angle of view of the camera is preserved? (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Kaamera

Juku pildistab virmalisi iseehitatud kaameraga, mis koosneb ruudukujulisest valgustundlikust elemendist külje pikkusega $2h=2{,}0\ \mathrm{cm}$ ja kumerläätsest fookuskaugusega $f=14\ \mathrm{cm}$. Jukule ei meeldi, et kaamera on niivõrd suur ja ta tahab, et kaamera oleks maksimaalselt $L_m=7{,}0\ \mathrm{cm}$ pikk. Selleks paigaldab ta vana kumerläätse asemel uue kumerläätse fookuskaugusega $f_2=3{,}0\ \mathrm{cm}$ valgustundlikust elemendist kaugusele $L_m$. Kui suure fookuskaugusega ja kui kaugele kumerläätsest peaks Juku süsteemi lisama ühe nõgusläätse, et säiliks kaamera esialgne vaatenurk? (10 p.)

problems.title: Two wires on a cylinder
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Roof

Two rigid pieces of wire of length $L$ are joined end to end (e.g. tied together with a thread) so that their end points are in contact and the angle between them can change without resistance, forming a V-shaped figure. This wire structure is placed on a horizontal cylinder with a smooth surface so that in the equilibrium position the wires form a "roof" (an upside-down "V") with apex angle $\alpha$. The mass distribution in the wire is uniform, and there is no friction between the wire and the cylinder. a) What is the radius $R$ of the cylinder? b) What inequality must be satisfied for this position to be stable (investigate stability only with respect to rotation of the "roof" as a whole, assuming that the angle between the wires does not change)? (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Katus

Kaks jäika traadijuppi pikkusega $L$ on ühendatud otsapidi (nt niidiga seotud) nii, et nende otspunktid on kontaktis ja nende vaheline nurk saab takistuseta muutuda, moodustades V-kujulise figuuri. See traadist moodustis asetatakse horisontaalse libedapinnalise silindri peale nõnda, et tasakaaluasendis moodustub traadist "katus" (tagurpidi "V") tipunurgaga $\alpha$. Massijaotus traadis on ühtlane, hõõre traadi ja silindri vahel puudub. a) Milline on silindri raadius $R$? b) Milline võrratus peab olema rahuldatud, et see asend oleks stabiilne (uurida stabiilsust vaid "katuse" kui terviku pöördumise suhtes eeldades, et traatidevaheline nurk ei muutu)? (12 p.)

problems.title: Electrons from a source on a screen in a magnetic field
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Electrons

In the region of space $x>-a$ ($a>0$) there is a uniform magnetic field of induction $B$ directed along the $z$-axis. At the origin of coordinates there is a source of electrons which emits electrons in equal numbers in all directions (over the solid angle $4\pi$). All electrons have speed $v$. In the plane $x=-a$ there is a screen. When electrons with charge $e$ and mass $m$ hit the screen, a glow is visible at the point of impact. Find the diameters of the glowing spot along the $z$- and $y$-axes, assuming that at least some of the electrons reach the screen. If one compares only the brightness of points lying on the $y$-axis, at which $y$-coordinate is the glow intensity of this spot greatest? (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Elektronid

Ruumipiirkonnas $x>-a$ ($a>0$) on homogeenne $z$-telje sihiline magnetväli induktsiooniga $B$. Koordinaatide alguspunktis on elektronide allikas, mis kiirgab elektrone võrdsel arvul kõikidesse suundadesse (üle ruuminurga $4\pi$). Kõikide elektronide kiirus on $v$. Tasandis $x=-a$ on ekraan. Kui elektronid laenguga $e$ ja massiga $m$ põrkuvad vastu ekraani, siis on kokkupõrkepunktis näha helendust. Leidke helenduva laigu $z$- ja $y$-telje sihilised läbimõõdud eeldusel, et vähemalt osa elektronidest jõuavad ekraanini. Kui võrrelda vaid $y$-teljel asuvate punktide heledusi, siis millisel $y$-koordinaadil on selle laigu helenduse intensiivsus kõige suurem? (12 p.)

problems.title: Lens above a mirror bottom under water
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Mirror bottom

A converging glass lens is placed in an empty vessel with a mirror bottom so that the optical axis of the lens is perpendicular to the bottom of the vessel. The distance of the lens from the bottom of the vessel is $10\ \mathrm{cm}$. A parallel light beam is directed at the lens, and after passing through the lens it converges at some point. Then the vessel is filled with water (the lens remains under water). The light beam still converges at the same point. Find the focal length of the lens in air. The refractive index of glass is $n_k=1.5$, that of water is $n_v=1.33$, and that of air is $n_a=1$. (8 points)

Note: the optical power of a thin convex lens is expressed as $D=\frac{(n-n_0)}{n_0}\left(\frac{1}{R_1}+\frac{1}{R_2}\right)$, where $n$ and $n_0$ are the refractive indices of the lens material and of the medium surrounding the lens, respectively, and $R_1$ and $R_2$ are the radii of curvature of the convex surfaces of the lens.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Peegelpõhi

Peegelpõhjaga tühja anumasse asetatakse koondav klaaslääts nii, et läätse optiline peatelg on risti anuma põhjaga. Läätse kaugus anuma põhjast on $10\ \mathrm{cm}$. Läätsele suunatakse paralleelne valgusvihk, mis koondub pärast läätse läbimist mingis punktis. Siis valatakse anum vett täis (lääts jääb vee alla). Valgusvihk koondub endiselt samas punktis. Leidke läätse fookuskaugus õhus. Klaasi murdumisnäitaja $n_k=1{,}5$, vee murdumisnäitaja $n_v=1{,}33$, õhu oma $n_a=1$. (8 p.)

Märkus: õhukese kumerläätse optiline tugevus avaldub kui $D=\frac{(n-n_0)}{n_0}\left(\frac{1}{R_1}+\frac{1}{R_2}\right)$, kus $n$ ja $n_0$ on vastavalt läätse materjali ja läätse ümbritseva keskkonna murdumisnäitajad ning $R_1$ ja $R_2$ on läätse kumerate pindade kõverusraadiused.

Problem 5: Insulation

The insulation of a wall consists of an inner layer (thermal conductivity $k_1=0.07\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) and an outer layer (thermal conductivity $k_2=0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$). Between these layers there is a film to prevent air from moving through the wall. What condition must the thickness $L_1$ of the inner insulation layer satisfy in order to avoid condensation of water vapour in the wall? The thickness of the wall is $L=L_1+L_2=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, where $L_2$ is the thickness of the outer insulation layer, the room temperature is $T_1=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, the relative humidity in the room is $\eta_1=60\ \%$ and the outside temperature is $T_2=-20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The dependence of the partial pressure of saturated water vapour on temperature is given in the figure. (10 points)

Note: Assume that the temperature changes linearly with distance in the insulation layer and that the rate of change is inversely proportional to the thermal conductivity.

problems.title: Height at which a helium balloon loses 1% of its lift
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Rising balloon

In nice sunny weather one usually has a so-called adiabatic atmosphere. This means that air masses are in constant up-and-down motion. When rising, the air expands and cools adiabatically; owing to continuous mixing, the temperature of the rising air mass equals the temperature of the surrounding air masses at the given height. It can be shown that in this case the temperature decreases linearly with height, $T=T_0-\frac{\gamma-1}{\gamma}\frac{\mu g h}{R}$, where $\gamma=1.4$ is the adiabatic index of air, $\mu=29\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ is the average molar mass of air, $g=9.81\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ is the acceleration of free fall, $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/mol\cdot K}$ is the gas constant, and $h$ is the height above the ground; the air temperature at the ground is $T_0=293\ \mathrm{K}$. A balloon made of inextensible but freely flexible skin can hold at most a volume $V_0$ of gas; it is filled with such an amount of helium that occupies volume $V_0/2$ at the ground. The balloon is released and begins to rise slowly; assume that the temperature of the helium in the balloon is at all times equal to the temperature of the surrounding air. Estimate at what height $h_1$ the lift of the balloon is $1\ \%$ smaller than at the ground. An estimate of the height with a relative error of no more than one tenth is expected from you, and there is no need to prove that the error is sufficiently small. (12 points)

Note: for an adiabatic process the relation $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$ holds, where $p$ denotes the gas pressure and $V$ the volume.
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Kerkiv õhupall

Ilusa päikeselise ilma korral on harilikult tegemist nn adiabaatilise atmosfääriga. See tähendab, et õhumassid on pidevas üles-alla liikumises. Kerkides õhk paisub ja jahtub adiabaatiliselt; pideva segunemise tõttu on kerkiva õhumassi temperatuur võrdne seda antud kõrgusel ümbritsevate õhumasside temperatuuriga. On võimalik näidata, et sellisel juhul kahaneb temperatuur lineaarselt kõrgusega, $T=T_0-\frac{\gamma-1}{\gamma}\frac{\mu g h}{R}$, kus $\gamma=1{,}4$ on õhu adiabaadinäitaja, $\mu=29\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ — õhu keskmine molaarmass, $g=9{,}81\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ — vabalangemise kiirendus, $R=8{,}31\ \mathrm{J/mol\cdot K}$ — gaasikonstant, ja $h$ — kõrgus maapinnast; õhutemperatuur maapinnal $T_0=293\ \mathrm{K}$. Venimatust kuid vabalt painduvast nahast valmistatud õhupall mahutab maksimaalselt ruumala $V_0$ jagu gaasi; see täidetakse sellise koguse heeliumiga, mis võtab maapinnal enda alla ruumala $V_0/2$. Õhupall lastakse lahti ja see hakkab aeglaselt kerkima; lugeda, et õhupallis oleva heeliumi temperatuur on kogu aeg võrdne ümbritseva õhu temperatuuriga. Hinnake, millisel kõrgusel $h_1$ on õhupalli tõstejõud $1\ \%$ võrra väiksem kui maapinnal. Teilt oodatakse sellist hinnangut kõrgusele, mille suhteline viga pole suurem ühest kümnendikust, kusjuures vea piisavat väiksust pole vaja tõestada. (12 p.)

Märkus: adiabaatilise protsessi korral kehtib seos $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$, kus $p$ tähistab gaasi rõhku ja $V$ — ruumala.

problems.title: Charge through a lamp in an RC-type circuit
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Capacitor

Consider the electric circuit shown in the figure, consisting of a capacitor of capacitance $C$, a battery of electromotive force $\mathcal{E}$, a resistor and an incandescent lamp, which may be considered a nonlinear resistor (the voltage depends nonlinearly on the current). Initially the capacitor was uncharged and the switch was open. Then the switch was closed for a short time, after which it was opened again and kept open until the capacitor had discharged completely. During the time the switch was closed, a total amount of heat $Q_1$ was released in the circuit; after the switch was opened, a further amount of heat $Q_2$ was released. Find the charge that passed through the lamp during the period when the switch was closed. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2018-9-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Kondensaator

Vaatleme joonisel kujutatud elektriskeemi, mis koosneb kondensaatorist mahtuvusega $C$, patareist elektromotoorjõuga $\mathcal{E}$, takistist ja hõõglambist, mida võib lugeda mittelineaarseks takistiks (pinge sõltub voolust mittelineaarselt). Algselt oli kondensaator laenguta ja lüliti oli avatud. Seejärel suleti lüliti lühikeseks ajaks, misjärel see avati uuesti ning hoiti lahtisena seni, kuni kondensaator oli täielikult tühjenenud. Selle aja jooksul, mil lüliti oli suletud, eraldus kogu skeemil soojushulk $Q_1$; lüliti avamise järel eraldus täiendavalt veel soojushulk $Q_2$. Leidke laeng, mis läbis hõõglambi sel perioodil, kui lüliti oli suletud. (12 p.)
