problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Romb

Laest ripub rombikujuline liigendiga konstruktsioon, mis on valmistatud massita varrastest pikkusega $l$, vt joonis. Silinder massiga $m$ pannakse rombi sisse. Selle tulemusel võtab romb tasakaaluasendi, kus rombi tipunurk on $2\alpha$. Hõõrdumine silindri ja varda vahel on tühiselt väike. Leidke silindri raadius. (12 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2024-7-fig1.png

problems.title: Triangle imaged by a lens
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Triangle

A converging lens with focal length $f$ forms, from a right-angled triangle with one angle of $30^\circ$, an image which is also a right-angled triangle with one angle of $30^\circ$. The hypotenuse of the triangle lies along the principal optical axis of the lens. Find the length of the hypotenuse of the triangle. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Kolmnurk

Koondav lääts fookuskaugusega $f$ tekitab täisnurksest kolmnurgast, mille üks nurk on $30^\circ$ kujutiseks kolmnurga, mis on samuti täisnurkne ja mille üks nurk on $30^\circ$. Kolmnurga hüpotenuus kulgeb piki läätse optilist peatelge. Leidke kolmnurga hüpotenuusi pikkus. (12 p.)

problems.title: Fog
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Fog

The molar mass of dry air (i.e. without any water vapour) is $\mu_a=28.97\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, the molar mass of water is $\mu_v=18.02\ \mathrm{g/mol}$. At a certain air pressure, at temperature $T_1=25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ the density of dry air is $\rho_k=1182.8\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$, and the density of a certain mass of moist air without fog droplets is $\rho=1169.3\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$. What is the density of this air mass at temperature $T_2=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, if it is known that at this temperature the density of saturated water vapour is $\rho_m=9.4\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$? Assume that the condensing fog droplets remain suspended in the air and that the density of water is much greater than that of air. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Udu

Kuiva (st ilma igasuguse veeauruta) õhu molaarmass $\mu_a=28{,}97\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, vee molaarmass $\mu_v=18{,}02\ \mathrm{g/mol}$. Teatud õhurõhu juures on temperatuuril $T_1=25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kuiva õhu tihedus $\rho_k=1182{,}8\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$ ning teatud niiske kuid udupiiskadeta õhumassi tihedus $\rho=1169{,}3\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$. Milline on selle õhumassi tihedus temperatuuril $T_2=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, kui on teada, et sellel temperatuuril on küllastunud veeauru tihedus $\rho_m=9{,}4\ \mathrm{g/m^3}$. Eeldage, et kondenseeruvad udupiisad jäävad õhku hõljuma ja et vee tihedus on palju suurem, kui õhu oma. (12 p.)

problems.title: Capacitor in a liquid
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Capacitor in a liquid

A parallel-plate capacitor with plate separation $d$ is in a vertical position and is immersed with its end in a liquid, as shown in the figure. The dielectric permittivity of the liquid is $\varepsilon$ and a voltage $V$ is applied to the plates of the capacitor. At what height $h$ is the liquid level in the space between the plates relative to the rest of the free surface of the liquid? The dielectric permittivity of the vacuum is $\varepsilon_0$, the dielectric permittivity of air is $\varepsilon_g=1$, the density of the liquid is $\rho$ and the free-fall acceleration is $g$. The surface tension of the liquid may be neglected; the height and width of the capacitor and the height of the air-filled part of the capacitor are much greater than $d$. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2024-10-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Kondensaator vedelikus

Plaatkondensaator plaatidevahelise kaugusega $d$ on vertikaalasendis ja otsapidi vedelikus nii, nagu näidatud joonisel. Vedeliku dielektriline läbitavus on $\varepsilon$ ja kondensaatori plaatidele on rakendatud pinge $V$. Kui kõrgel $h$ on plaatide vahelises ruumiosas vedeliku nivoo võrreldes ülejäänud vaba vedeliku pinnaga? Vaakumi dielektriline läbitavus on $\varepsilon_0$, õhu dielektriline läbitavus $\varepsilon_g=1$, vedeliku tihedus on $\rho$ ja vabalangemise kiirendus on $g$. Vedeliku pindpinevusega võib mitte arvestada; kondensaatori kõrgus ja laius ning õhuga täidetud kondensaatoriosa kõrgus on palju suuremad, kui $d$. (12 p.)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2024-10-fig1.png

problems.title: Cup
problems.problem:
Problem 1: Cup

Tarmo has a cup from which he drinks water all day. On waking up in the morning he fills the initially empty cup with water. In $T=10$ minutes he drinks, at a uniform rate, exactly half of the water in the cup, after which he lets water from the tap into the cup until it is full again. After that he again drinks the cup half empty in $T=10$ minutes at a uniform rate, then fills the cup again, etc., continuing like this until the evening, and pours the cup empty when going to bed. Find the average time spent in the cup among all the water molecules that were in the cup at some moment during the day. You may assume that Tarmo's waking time is much longer than $T$ and that the time needed to fill the cup is negligible. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 1: Tass

Tarmol on tass, millest ta päev otsa vett joob. Hommikul üles ärgates täidab ta algselt tühja tassi veega. $T=10$ minutiga joob Tarmo ühtlase kiirusega ära täpselt pool tassis olevast veest, pärast mida laseb ta tassi kraanist vett juurde, kuni see on jälle täis. Pärast seda joob ta jälle $T=10$ minutiga ühtlase kiirusega tassi pooltühjaks, täidab siis tassi jälle jne, jätkates nii õhtuni, valades magama minnes tassi tühjaks. Leidke keskmine tassis veedetud aeg kõigi päeva jooksul mõnel hetkel tassis olnud veemolekulide seas. Võite eeldada, et Tarmo ärkveloleku aeg on palju pikem kui $T$ ning tassi täitmisele kuluv aeg on tühine. (8 p.)

problems.title: Bus ride
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Bus ride

Rando was travelling by bus and noticed that water had collected between the window panes of the bus. A county-line bus is driving along flat Estonian terrain and has already been driving at the speed limit for quite a while. Since the bus stop was already in sight, the bus began to brake uniformly with acceleration $a$. As a result the water between the window panes began to move until it had reached a new equilibrium position. Find the change in the potential energy of the water caused by the braking of the bus. The length of the space between the panes is $x$, its height is $h$ and its thickness is $d$. The height of the water is $h_0$, and there is just so much of it that the bottom of the space between the panes is always covered and the water does not reach the top ceiling. The density of water is $\rho$, the gravitational acceleration of the Earth is $g$, and surface tension need not be taken into account. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Bussisõit

Rando sõitis bussiga ja märkas, et bussi aknaklaaside vahele on vett kogunenud. Maakonnaliini buss sõidab mööda tasast Eestimaad ja on juba pikemat aega piirkiirusel sõitnud. Kuna bussipeatus oli juba nähtaval, hakkas buss ühtlaselt pidurdama kiirendusega $a$. Seepeale hakkas vesi bussi aknaklaaside vahel liikuma, kuni see oli uude tasakaaluasendisse jõudnud. Leidke bussi pidurdamisest tingitud veehulga potentsiaalse energia muut. Klaaside vahelise ruumi pikkus on $x$, kõrgus on $h$ ja paksus on $d$. Vee kõrgus on $h_0$ ja seda on just nii palju, et klaaside vahelise ruumi põhi on alati kaetud ja ülemise laeni see ei ulatu. Vee tihedus on $\rho$, Maa raskuskiirendus on $g$ ja pindpinevusega ei pea arvestama. (8 p.)

problems.title: Two lenses
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Two lenses

The figure shows the planes of two converging lenses and the path of a narrow parallel beam of rays entering the system. Construct the principal optical axes of the lenses, given that the beam of rays leaving the system is also parallel and twice as wide as the entering one. Solve the problem on the additional sheet. (8 points)

problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Kaks läätse

Joonisel on kujutatud kahe koondava läätse tasandid ja süsteemi siseneva kitsa paralleelse kiirtekimbu käik. Konstrueerige läätsede optilised peateljed, kui on teada, et süsteemist väljunud kiirtekimp on samuti paralleelne ja kaks korda laiem sisenevast. Lahendage ülesanne lisalehel. (8 p.)

problems.title: Canned soup
problems.problem:
Problem 4: Canned soup

Cans of soup are usually marked with a volume of $500\ \mathrm{ml}$. But when measured more closely, it turns out that the can actually holds $580\ \mathrm{ml}$ of liquid. Modern cans also have a so-called safety button, by which one can determine whether the can has been opened: if the button is pressed in, there is an under-pressure in the can, which means that the can has not been opened after it was sealed.

a) What must, approximately, have been the minimum temperature of the soup at the moment it was put into the can for the safety button to close, given that pressing the button down takes $5\ \mathrm{N}$, the diameter of the button is $2.5\ \mathrm{cm}$, the heat capacity of the air is negligible compared with that of the soup, and the thermal expansion of the soup is negligible under the given conditions.

b) With what force must the lid of the can be turned in order to open it, given that the temperature of the soup at the moment it was put into the can was $90\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$? The diameter of the can lid is $8.4\ \mathrm{cm}$ and the pitch angle of the thread of the can is $6^\circ$.

The room temperature is $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and the air pressure is $101\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Do not take into account the effects arising from the condensation of water vapour. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Purgisupp

Purgisuppide peale on tavaliselt märgitud maht $500\ \mathrm{ml}$. Kuid kui lähemalt mõõta, tuleb välja, et tegelikult mahub purki $580\ \mathrm{ml}$ vedelikku. Moodsatel purkidel on ka n-ö turvanupp, mille järgi saab määrata, kas purki on avatud – kui nupp on sissevajutatud, on purgis alarõhk, mis tähendab, et purki pole pärast sulgemist avatud.

a) Mis pidi hinnanguliselt olema supi minimaalne temperatuur purki panemise hetkel, et turvanupp sulguks, kui nupu alla vajutamiseks kulub $5\ \mathrm{N}$, nupu läbimõõt on $2{,}5\ \mathrm{cm}$, õhu soojusmahtuvus võrreldes supiga on tühine ning supi soojuspaisumine on antud oludes tühine.

b) Mis jõuga peab purgikaant keerama, et see lahti saada, kui on teada, et supi temperatuur purki panemise hetkel oli $90\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$? Purgikaane läbimõõt on $8{,}4\ \mathrm{cm}$ ja purgi keeru tõusunurk on $6^\circ$.

Toatemperatuur on $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ning õhurõhk $101\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Veeauru kondenseerumisest tekkivate efektidega mitte arvestada. (8 p.)

problems.title: Rod in orbit
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Rod in orbit

Consider a rod of length $L$ that is positioned vertically ($L$ is parallel to the radius vector) in a circular orbit at a distance $R$ from the centre of the Earth. Find the stress, i.e. the ratio of the tension force to the cross-sectional area of the rod, at the centre of the rod, assuming that $L\ll R$. The density of the rod is $\rho$, the mass of the Earth is $M$ and the gravitational constant is $G$.

Hint: if $L\ll R$, the gravitational force as a function of the distance from the centre of the rod can be linearised, i.e. one can use the approximation $1/(R+x)^2\approx 1/R^2-2x/R^3$. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Latt orbiidil

Vaatleme latti pikkusega $L$, mis asub vertikaalselt ($L$ on parallelne raadiusvektoriga) ringorbiidil kaugusel $R$ Maa keskpunktist. Leida pinge, st pingejõu ja lati ristlõikepindala suhe, lati keskpunktis eeldusel, et $L\ll R$. Lati tihedus on $\rho$, Maa mass $M$ ning gravitatsioonikonstant $G$.

Vihje: kui $L\ll R$, siis võib raskusjõu funktsioonina kaugusest lati keskpunktist lineariseerida, st kasutada lähendust $1/(R+x)^2\approx 1/R^2-2x/R^3$. (8 p.)

problems.title: LEDs
problems.problem:
Problem 6: LEDs

A room is lit by a number of light-emitting diodes. To keep them running, a direct-current source is used, which delivers to the pair of wires leading to the diodes a direct current of $I_0=2\ \mathrm{A}$, provided that the voltage between the wires does not exceed $U_0=24\ \mathrm{V}$. If the voltage $U_0$ is not sufficient to reach the current $I_0$, then the voltage between the wires equals $U_0$. The light-emitting diodes are connected in series and their total power in the operating mode is $P_0=38\ \mathrm{W}$. A pair of copper wires of length $l=10\ \mathrm{m}$ leads from the source to the diodes; the diameter of the wire is $d=1\ \mathrm{mm}$ and the distance between the axes of the two wires is $a=5\ \mathrm{mm}$. To calculate the inductance of the wire pair per unit length you may use the formula $\lambda=\frac{\mu_0}{\pi}\ln a/d$, where $\mu_0=4\pi\cdot 10^{-7}\ \mathrm{H/m}$. For the light-emitting diodes a simplified model may be used: as long as the voltage across a diode is smaller than the so-called threshold voltage, no current flows through the diode; if current flows through the diode, then the voltage across the diode equals the threshold voltage.

Initially the system is switched off. How long does it take after connecting the power supply for the diodes to reach full power? Sketch on a graph how the power of the current source depends on time after the switch of the circuit is closed. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Valgusdioodid

Tuba valgustatakse hulga valgusdioodide abil. Nende tööshoidmiseks kasutatakse alalisvoolu allikat, mis annab dioodideni viivasse juhtmepaari alalisvoolu tugevusega $I_0=2\ \mathrm{A}$ eeldusel, et juhtmete vaheline pinge ei ületa pinget $U_0=24\ \mathrm{V}$. Kui pingest $U_0$ ei piisa voolutugevuse $I_0$ saavutamiseks, siis on juhtmete vaheline pinge võrdne $U_0$-ga. Valgudioodid on ühendatud järjestikku ja nende koguvõimsus on töörežiimis $P_0=38\ \mathrm{W}$. Allikast dioodideni viib $l=10\ \mathrm{m}$ pikkune vasktraadipaar, traadi diameeter on $d=1\ \mathrm{mm}$ ja kahe traadi telgede vahekaugus — $a=5\ \mathrm{mm}$. Ühikulise pikkusega traadipaari induktiivsuse arvutamiseks võite kasutada valemit $\lambda=\frac{\mu_0}{\pi}\ln a/d$, kus $\mu_0=4\pi\cdot 10^{-7}\ \mathrm{H/m}$. Valgusdioodide jaoks võib kasutada lihtsustatud mudelit: seni, kuni dioodi pinge on väiksem nn avanemispingest, dioodi vool ei läbi; kui dioodi läbib vool, siis on dioodi pinge võrdne avanemispingega.

Algul on süsteem välja lülitatud. Kui kaua kulub peale toiteallika ühendamist aega, et dioodid saavutaksid täisvõimsuse? Visandage graafikul, kuidas sõltub vooluallika võimsus ajast peale vooluahela lüliti sulgemist. (10 p.)

The side length of a chess square is $d=3\ \mathrm{cm}$. Do not take into account spherical effects arising from the curvature of the lens. You may make measurements on the additional sheet (on the black-and-white pictures). (10 points)

On teada, et kaamerat nihutati esimese ja teise foto vahel horisontaaltasandis $s=2\ \mathrm{cm}$ võrra paralleelselt malelaua servaga. Maleruudu servapikkus on $d=3\ \mathrm{cm}$. problems.title: Glider
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Glider

A glider of mass $m=120\ \mathrm{kg}$ is at a height of $h=500\ \mathrm{m}$ above the ground. The air resistance acting on the glider is given by the formula $F_t=kv^2C_d$, where $k$ is a constant with the value $0.5\ \mathrm{kg/m}$, $v$ is the speed of the aircraft and $C_d$ is a coefficient. The lift force of the wings is given by the formula $F_l=kv^2C_l$, where $k$ and $v$ are the same as in the air-resistance formula and $C_l$ is another coefficient. The values of the coefficients describing the air resistance and the lift force of the wings depend on the angle of the wing relative to the fuselage of the aircraft, and the pilot can change it as needed. The gravitational acceleration is $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, and one may in addition assume that $C_l\gg C_d$ holds in the situation under study. What is the longest possible flight time of the glider, if the speed of the aircraft is uniform and the flight takes place in still air? In the solution use the accompanying graph describing the dependence of $C_l$ on $C_d$. (12 points)

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/physics-olympiads-bank/main/images/eefo-2025-8-fig1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Purilennuk

Purilennuk massiga $m=120\ \mathrm{kg}$ asub maapinnast $h=500\ \mathrm{m}$ kõrgusel. Purilennukile mõjuv õhutakistus avaldub valemiga $F_t=kv^2C_d$, kus $k$ on konstant väärtusega $0{,}5\ \mathrm{kg/m}$, $v$ lennuki kiirus ja $C_d$ koefitsent. Tiibade tõstejõud avaldub valemiga $F_l=kv^2C_l$, kus $k$ ja $v$ ühtivad õhutakistuse valemiga ja $C_l$ on teine koefitsent. Õhutakistust ja tiibade tõstejõudu kirjeldavate koefitsentide väärtused sõltuvad tiiva nurgast lennuki kere suhtes ja seda saab piloot vastavalt vajadusele muuta. Raskuskiirendus on $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, lisaks võib eeldada, et uuritavas olukorras kehtib $C_l\gg C_d$. Kui pikk on maksimaalne võimalik purilennuki lennuaeg, kui lennuki kiirus on ühtlane ning lend toimub paigal seisvas õhus? Lahendamisel kasutage juuresolevat $C_l$ ja $C_d$ sõltuvust kirjeldavat graafikut. (12 p.)

problems.title: Soap bubble
problems.problem:
Problem 9: Soap bubble

A soap bubble of radius $R=1\ \mathrm{cm}$ attaches to a water surface. By how much did the pressure inside the soap bubble change during this process? In the calculations you may make reasonable approximations. Did the volume of the soap bubble increase or decrease? The surface tension coefficient of soapy water is $\sigma=36\cdot 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N/m}$; the process takes place at atmospheric pressure $P_0=1.01\cdot 10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Seebimull

Seebimull raadiusega $R=1\ \mathrm{cm}$ kleepub vastu veepinda. Kui palju muutus selle protsessi käigus rõhk seebimulli sees? Arvutustes võite teha mõistlikke lähendusi. Kas seebimulli ruumala kasvas või kahanes? Seebise vee pindpinevustegur $\sigma=36\cdot 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{N/m}$; protsess toimub atmosfäärirõhul $P_0=1{,}01\cdot 10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Electron and solenoid
problems.problem:
Problem 10: Electron and solenoid

The number of turns of a solenoid (a cylindrical helix) is $N$, its radius is $r$ and its length is $L$, with $r\ll L$, and a current $I$ flows through the solenoid. An electron is shot into the solenoid from one end with speed $v$. By how much do the maximum and minimum times needed to pass through the solenoid differ, such that the electron leaves the solenoid from the other end? The entry point and angle of the electron can be chosen freely. The mass of the electron is $m$ and its charge is $-e$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 10: Elektron ja solenoid

Solenoidi (silindriline heeliks) keerdude arv on $N$, raadius on $r$ ja pikkus on $L$, kusjuures $r\ll L$, ja solenoidi läbib vool tugevusega $I$. Solenoidi ühest otsast sisse tulistatakse elektron kiirusega $v$. Kui palju erineb solenoidi läbimiseks kuluv maksimaalne ja minimaalne aeg nii, et elektron väljub solenoidi teisest otsast? Elektroni sisenemiskoht ja -nurk on vabalt valitavad. Elektroni mass on $m$ ja laeng on $-e$. (12 p.)

problems.title: Motion of a light source
problems.problem:
Problem 2: Motion of a light source

An optical setup consists of a thin converging lens with focal length $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$. The lens is positioned so that a plane mirror is placed perpendicular to its axis, at a distance $d=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ behind the lens, measured from the centre of the lens. A point light source is located in front of the lens at a distance $a=30\ \mathrm{cm}$ from the lens. The light source begins to move towards the lens with speed $v=1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Estimate the speed with which the image formed by the optical system consisting of the lens and the mirror begins to move at that moment. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 2: Valgusallika liikumine

Optiline skeem koosneb õhukesest koondavast läätsest, mille fookuskaugus on $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$. Lääts on paigutatud nii, et selle teljega risti asetseb tasapeegel, mis on läätse taga $d=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ kaugusel läätse keskpunktist. Punktvalgusallikas paikneb läätse ees $a=30\ \mathrm{cm}$ kaugusel läätsest. Valgusallikas hakkab liikuma läätse suunas kiirusega $v=1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Hinnake, millise kiirusega hakkab sel hetkel liikuma kujutis, mille tekitab läätsest ja peeglist koosnev optiline süsteem? (8 p)

problems.title: Bungee jump
problems.problem:
Problem 3: Bungee jump

Tuuli is looking for maximum experience in life, which is why she engages in extreme hobbies. This time she has decided to take up bungee jumping. To push her experience to the limit of tension, she wants to experience the maximum acceleration that a human can tolerate briefly, $a=9g$. Since Tuuli does not have such a strong elastic rope, she decides to fold her existing rope in half and jump like that. After the jump she looks at her measuring device, which shows that the maximum instantaneous acceleration was only $7g$. The elastic force arising in the elastic rope is proportional to the extension; disregard the mass of the elastic rope and the air resistance.

a) By how many percent did the rope stretch at its maximum compared with its rest length?

b) Although the first jump was successful and the acceleration experienced was at the human limit, Tuuli wanted to fall a longer distance. For that she unfolded her rope so that it now lay single. At the lowest point of the jump Tuuli noticed that the ground came so close that she could freely touch it with her hand. How long is the elastic rope at rest, given that the tower Tuuli used for jumping was $100\ \mathrm{m}$ high? Regard the height of the person as negligible compared with the tower. (8 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 3: Benji-hüpe

Tuuli otsib elust maksimaalset elamust, mistõttu tegeleb ta ekstreemsete hobidega. Seekord on ta otsustanud ette võtta Benji-hüpped. Oma kogemuse pingete piirile viimiseks, soovib ta kogeda maksimaalset kiirendust, mida inimene lühiajaliselt talub $a=9g$. Kuna Tuulil nii tugevat elastset köit ei ole, siis otsustab ta oma olemasoleva köie pooleks voltida ja sedasi hüpata. Pärast hüpet vaatab ta oma mõõteseadet, millelt on näha, et maksimaalne hetkeline kiirendus oli ainult $7g$. Elastses köies tekkiv elastsusjõud on võrdeline pikenemisega ning elastse köie massi ja õhutakistust mitte arvestada.

a) Mitu protsenti venis köis maksimumis pikemaks võrreldes puhkeolekuga?

b) Kuigi esimene hüpe oli edukas ja kogetud kiirendus inimpiiridel, soovis Tuuli pikemat maad kukkuda. Selleks voltis ta oma köie lahti, nii et see lebas nüüd ühekordselt. Hüppe haripunkti ajal märkas Tuuli, et maapind tuli nii lähedale, et ta sai seda vabalt käega ära puudutada. Kui pikk on elastne köis puhkeolekus kui on teada, et torn, mida Tuuli kasutas hüppamiseks oli $100\ \mathrm{m}$ kõrge. Inimese pikkus võrreldes torniga lugeda tühiseks. (8 p)

problems.title: New asphalt
problems.problem:
Problem 4: New asphalt

A layer of new asphalt has been laid on a certain section of a highway. The layer of new asphalt ends with a sharp, abrupt edge; on both the new and the old asphalt part the road is smooth and horizontal, but the new part is slightly higher. A car drives off the new-asphalt part onto the old asphalt. What should the speed of a four-wheeled passenger car be so that the wheels never lose contact with the asphalt? The total mass of the car (without the wheels) is $M=1500\ \mathrm{kg}$, the total mass of each wheel (including the masses of the tyre, rim, wheel bearings, etc.) is $m=40\ \mathrm{kg}$ and its radius is $R=35\ \mathrm{cm}$. You may assume that (a) each wheel is attached to the body by means of a spring so that the mass $M$ rests on four springs; (b) the thickness of the new asphalt layer is much smaller than both the radius of the wheels and the deformations of the springs; (c) the centre of mass of the car is at an equal distance from each wheel. The free-fall acceleration is $g=9.8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 4: Uus asfalt

Maantee teatud teelõigule on pandud kiht uut asfalti. Uue asfalti kiht lõpeb ära järsu ja terava servaga; nii uue kui vana asfaldiga osas on tee sile ja horisontaalne, kuid uus osa on natuke kõrgem. Auto sõidab mööda uue asfaldiga osalt maha vana asfaldi peale. Milline peaks olema neljarattalise sõiduauto kiirus, et rattad kordagi asfaldiga kontakti ei kaotaks? Auto kogumass (ilma ratasteta) $M=1500\ \mathrm{kg}$, iga ratta kogumass (mis sisaldab rehvi, velje, rattalaagrite jms masse) $m=40\ \mathrm{kg}$ ja raadius $R=35\ \mathrm{cm}$. Võite eeldada, et (a) iga ratas on kere külge kinnitatud vedru abil nii, et mass $M$ toetub neljale vedrule; (b) uue asfaldikihi paksus on hulga väiksem nii rataste raadiusest kui vedrude deformatsioonidest; (c) auto massikese on igast rattast võrdsel kaugusel. Vabalangemise kiirendus $g=9{,}8\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. (10 p)

problems.title: Painting a wall
problems.problem:
Problem 5: Painting a wall

A spray can contains $V=1\ \mathrm{L}$ of paint mixture. A fraction $k=0.3$ of the paint mixture is paint and the rest is propane for spraying the paint, and this ratio does not change as the can empties. The specific heat of the paint mixture is $c=2500\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$ and the heat of vaporisation of propane is $L=420\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$. The density of both propane and paint is $\rho=550\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. The user presses the spray button, but the paint is sprayed out through the hose only if the overpressure inside the can exceeds $p_{\min}=200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Estimate how many square metres of wall can be covered with a paint layer of $d=0.2\ \mathrm{mm}$ over a short period of time, if the can conducts heat very poorly. The initial temperature of the paint mixture is $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and the atmospheric pressure is $p_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Below is the graph of the saturated vapour pressure of propane. (10 points)

problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 5: Seina värvimine

Spreipurgis on $V=1\ \mathrm{L}$ värvisegu. Värvisegu on $k=0.3$ osa värv ning ülejäänu on propaan värvi pihustamiseks ja purgi tühjenemise käigus see vahekord ei muutu. Värvisegu erisoojus on $c=2500\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$ ning propaani aurustumissoojus on $L=420\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$. Nii propaani kui värvi tihedus on $\rho=550\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Kasutaja vajutab pihustusnuppu, kuid värv pihustub vooliku kaudu välja ainult juhul, kui purgisisene ülerõhk ületab $p_{\min}=200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Hinnake, mitu ruutmeetrit seina saab $d=0{,}2\ \mathrm{mm}$ värvikihiga katta lühikise aja jooksul, kui purk juhib väga kehvasti soojust? Värvisegu esialgne temperatuur on $T_0=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ja atmosfäärirõhk $p_0=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. All on propaani küllastusrõhu graafik. (10 p)

problems.title: Turning aeroplane
problems.problem:
Problem 6: Turning aeroplane

An aeroplane flies above the ground (gravitational acceleration $g$) at constant speed and constant altitude, and turns in such a way that, looking out of the window perpendicular to the aeroplane's direction of motion in the horizontal plane, one sees a fixed point on the ground.

A physicist passenger happens to have a stopwatch and a sextant with them and finds that the aeroplane turns at an angle $\phi$ to the horizon and that a full turn takes time $T$. What are the speed $v$ and the altitude $h$ of the aeroplane?

It will be useful to know that the lift force of the aeroplane is perpendicular to the horizontal plane of the aeroplane. (10 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 6: Pöörav lennuk

Lennuk lendab maa kohal (raskuskiirendus $g$) konstantse kiirusega konstantsel kõrgusel ja pöörab niimoodi, et lennuki liikumissuunaga risti horisontaaltasandis aknast välja vaadates näeb maapinnal fikseeritud punkti.

Füüsikust reisijal on õnneks kaasas stopper ja sekstant ning ta leiab, et lennuk pöörab nurga $\phi$ all horisondi suhtes ja täispöörde tegemiseks kulub aeg $T$. Mis on lennuki kiirus $v$ ja kõrgus $h$?

Tuleb kasuks teadmine, et lennuki tõstejõud on risti lennuki horisontaaltasandiga. (10 p)

problems.title: Free electricity
problems.problem:
Problem 7: Free electricity

Piret notices that on a cold winter evening the voltage in her country house (which is the only consumer on the line coming from the substation) is suspiciously low: the water in the electric kettle heats up slowly. She decides to investigate the situation using a voltmeter and the house's electricity meter.

The electricity meter shows a total consumed power of $P=4.2\ \mathrm{kW}$.

The voltage between the supply wires of the socket (phase and neutral) is $U_{FN}=210\ \mathrm{V}$.

The voltage between the neutral terminal of the socket and the earthing wire is $U_{NM}=16\ \mathrm{V}$.

Seeing the voltage at the neutral terminal, Piret gets the idea that perhaps the voltage between the neutral terminal and the ground ($U_{NM}$) could be used as a “free” energy source. She connects a heater (a resistor) between the neutral terminal of the socket and the earthing wire.

a) What resistance $R_k$ should Piret's heater have so that the power obtained is maximal, and how large is this power $P_{\max}$? (8 points)

b) The next day there is a storm and at the substation the neutral wire of the cable breaks (the phase wire remains intact). The electrical appliances of the house are still switched on. What power is now dissipated in Piret's heater? (4 points)

Assumptions:

A ground cable leads from the substation to the house, consisting of two identical copper wires: the phase wire and the neutral wire.

At the substation the end of the phase wire is held at a certain constant voltage $U_0$ relative to the ground, and the neutral wire is properly earthed there, i.e. its voltage relative to the ground is $0\ \mathrm{V}$.

The earthing wire of the house is also very well earthed and its resistance is negligibly small.

All household electrical consumers can be regarded as resistors. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 7: Tasuta elekter

Piret märkab, et külmal talveõhtul on ta maamajas (mis on alajaamast tuleval liinil ainus tarbija) elektripinge kahtlaselt madal – vesi soojeneb elektrikeetjas aeglaselt. Ta otsustab olukorda uurida, kasutades voltmeetrit ja maja elektriarvestit.

Elektriarvesti näitab tarbitavaks koguvõimsuseks $P=4{,}2\ \mathrm{kW}$.

Pinge pistikupesa toitejuhtmete (faas ja null) vahel on $U_{FN}=210\ \mathrm{V}$.

Pinge pistikupesa null-klemmi ja maandusjuhtme vahel on $U_{NM}=16\ \mathrm{V}$.

Nähes null-klemmi pinget, tekib Piretil mõte, et ehk saab null-klemmi ja maapinna vahelist pinget ($U_{NM}$) kasutada „tasuta” energiaallikana. Ta ühendab pistikupesa null-klemmi ja maandusjuhtme vahele küttekeha (takisti).

a) Millise takistusega $R_k$ peaks Pireti küttekeha olema, et saadav võimsus oleks maksimaalne, ja kui suur on see võimsus $P_{\max}$? (8 p.)

b) Järgmisel päeval on torm ning alajaama juures katkeb kaabli nulljuhe (faasijuhe jääb terveks). Maja elektriseadmed on endiselt sisse lülitatud. Milline võimsus eraldub nüüd Pireti küttekehal? (4 p.)

Eeldused:

Alajaamast tuleb majani maakaabel, mis koosneb kahest ühesugusest vasktraadist: faasijuhe ja nulljuhe.

Alajaama juures hoitakse faasijuhtme otsa maapinna suhtes teatud püsiva pinge $U_0$ juures ja nulljuhe on seal korralikult maandatud, st selle pinge on maapinna suhtes $0\ \mathrm{V}$.

Maja maandusjuhe on samuti väga hästi maandatud ja selle takistus on tühiselt väike.

Kõiki majapidamise elektritarbijaid võib vaadelda kui takisteid. (12 p)

problems.title: Microphone
problems.problem:
Problem 8: Microphone

The figure gives an example of the electrical circuit of a condenser microphone, where a voltmeter acts as the output of the microphone. The microphone has a capacitor consisting of two plates; in the normal position its capacitance is $C$ and the plate separation is $d$. The capacitor is connected in series with a resistor $R$ and a voltage source $U$. Due to a sound wave the left plate of the capacitor oscillates to a distance $x$ from its normal position according to the equation $x=h|t-2nT|/T$, where $h\ll d$, $T$ is the half-period of the sound wave and $n$ is an integer, see the graph. Sketch a graph of the voltmeter output as a function of time when (a) $T\gg CR$ and (b) $T\ll CR$. (12 points)

problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 8: Mikrofon

Joonisel on toodud näide kondensaatormikrofoni elektriskeemist, kus voltmeeter käitub mikrofoni väljundina. Mikrofonil on kahest plaadist koosnev kondensaator; normaalasendis on selle mahtuvus $C$ ning plaadivahe $d$. Kondensaator on ühendatud jadamisi takistiga $R$ ning pingeallikaga $U$. Tänu helilainele võngub vasak kondensaatori plaat oma normaalasendist kaugusele $x$ vastavalt võrrandile $x=h|t-2nT|/T$, kus $h\ll d$, $T$ on helilaine poolperiood ja $n$ on täisarv, vt graafikut. Visandage graafik voltmeetri väljundist ajas, kui (a) $T\gg CR$ ning (b) $T\ll CR$. (12 p)

Problem 9: Titicaca

Lake Titicaca lies on the Andean high plateau in Peru at an altitude of $h=3800\ \mathrm{m}$. The nearest coastal point on the Pacific Ocean is about $300\ \mathrm{km}$ away at sea level, where the air temperature is $t_1=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The weather station in the city of Puno on the shore of Lake Titicaca records an air temperature of $t_2=16\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Find the air density in Puno, expressed as a multiple of the sea-level density $\rho_0$.

Hint: near the Pacific coast the atmosphere is adiabatic, i.e. slowly rising and adiabatically expanding air is at every height in mechanical equilibrium with the surrounding air. For such slowly and equilibrium-wise rising air the law of conservation of energy holds (the analogue of Bernoulli's law for a gas) $c_p'T+gz+v^2/2=\mathrm{const}$, where $z$ is the height, $c_p'=1003\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$ is the specific heat capacity of air at constant pressure and the speed is $v=0$. For an adiabatic process $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$, where $V$ denotes the volume of the gas, and for air $\gamma=7/5$. (12 points)
problems.problem_orig:
Ülesanne 9: Titicaca

Titicaca järv asub Andide kõrgplatool Peruus kõrgusel $h=3800\ \mathrm{m}$. Lähim rannikupunkt Vaikse ookeani ääres on umbes $300\ \mathrm{km}$ kaugusel merepinna tasandil, kus õhutemperatuur on $t_1=20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ilmajaam Puno linnas Titicaca järve kaldal registreerib õhutemperatuuriks $t_2=16\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Leidke õhutihedus Punos, väljendatuna meretasandi tiheduse $\rho_0$ kordajana.

Vihje: Vaikse ookeani ranniku lähedal on atmosfäär adiabaatiline, st aeglaselt tõusev ja adiabaatiliselt paisuv õhk on igal kõrgusel mehaanilises tasakaalus ümbritseva õhuga. Sellise aeglaselt ja tasakaaluliselt kerkiva õhu jaoks kehtib energia jäävuse seadus (Bernoulli seaduse analoog gaasi jaoks) $c_p'T+gz+v^2/2=\mathrm{const}$, kus $z$ on kõrgus, $c_p'=1003\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$ on õhu erisoojusmahtuvus konstantsel rõhul ja kiirus $v=0$. Adiabaatilise protsessi korral $pV^\gamma=\mathrm{const}$, kus $V$ tähistab gaasi ruumala ja õhu jaoks $\gamma=7/5$. (12 p)

Problem 10: Water lens

A drop of water of volume $V=0.50\ \mathrm{ml}$ is placed on a thin horizontal glass plate. The radius of the contact circle between the drop and the glass is $r=1.0\ \mathrm{cm}$. The drop is so small that the influence of gravity on its shape can be considered negligible. Find the focal length $f$ of such a little water lens. The refractive index of water is $n=1.33$. (12 points)

Ülesanne 10: Vesilääts

Õhukesele horisontaalsele klaasplaadile asetatakse veetilk ruumalaga $V=0{,}50\ \mathrm{ml}$. Tilga ja klaasi kokkupuuteringi raadius on $r=1{,}0\ \mathrm{cm}$. Tilk on nii väike, et raskusjõu mõju tema kujule võib lugeda tühiseks. Leidke sellise veeläätsekese fookuskaugus $f$. Vee murdumisnäitaja $n=1{,}33$. (12 p)
